items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- Nine issuers have objected to trading of their shares on OKXICE TSV, the planned tokenized stock venue from OKX and NYSE owner ICE, according to an Oct. 15 public notice.
- Nasdaq has said it will opt its own shares out of the SEC’s innovation exemption, citing concerns about real-time pricing and trade reporting.
- The notice says OKXICE isn’t registered with the SEC or subject to Regulation NMS. It doesn’t say whether the objections will keep those stocks off the platform.
Wall Street’s push to put stocks onchain is running into an unexpected obstacle: the companies behind the stocks.
Nine issuers, including Verizon, Broadcom, and UnitedHealth Group, have objected to having their shares offered on OKXICE TSV, according to an Oct. 15 public notice from the venue.
OKXICE TSV is a planned tokenized stock platform from crypto exchange OKX and NYSE owner Intercontinental Exchange. The other objecting companies are Cerebras Systems, AppLovin, Applied Digital, Rocket Lab, CoreWeave, and Applied Optoelectronics.
The notice didn’t say why the companies objected or whether the objections will keep their shares off the platform.
Nasdaq is also keeping its distance. The exchange operator, which isn’t among the nine, has said it would opt its own shares out of the SEC’s framework. A spokesperson told The Wall Street Journal that Nasdaq doesn’t want its stock trading on a venue that doesn’t show the best prices in real time or report trades to the consolidated tape. That’s notable given that Nasdaq won SEC approval earlier this year for its own tokenized securities pilot.
The venue is the first major test of the SEC’s innovation exemption, which the agency unveiled in September after the Clarity Act stalled in the Senate. The exemption lets qualifying platforms trade tokenized U.S. stocks without registering as exchanges. OKXICE plans to run around the clock using Uniswap v4 liquidity pools on OKX’s XLayer blockchain, with trades settled in stablecoins such as USDC and USDT.
The tokens are created by a third party, not the companies themselves. That outside “tokenizer” holds actual shares one-for-one through a registered broker-dealer, and token holders are supposed to receive the same dividends and voting rights as regular shareholders, according to the notice.
The notice also lays out what users give up. OKXICE isn’t registered with the SEC, isn’t subject to Regulation NMS rules designed to ensure investors get the best displayed prices, and doesn’t have to provide fair access to all participants. Trading is capped at a small slice of each stock’s normal volume, and administrators can upgrade the venue’s smart contracts without advance notice.
OKX and ICE first teamed up on tokenized securities earlier this year before announcing the 24/7 venue this month. In terms of appetite from traders and investors for tokenized stocks, the International Monetary Fund recently found real demand for tokenized stocks—especially outside of traditional market hours—but warned that the market remains volatile and illiquid.

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- DHS directed U.S. civilian agencies on Monday to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built on the model from their IT systems, and barred new purchases.
- The notice says DeepSeek use "may result in the transfer of sensitive data to the PRC" and could produce intelligence on U.S. persons and agencies.
- The Commerce Department, the Navy, New York, Tennessee and Virginia had already restricted DeepSeek; the FCC votes October 29 on barring Chinese labs from testing electronics for U.S. use.
The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered civilian government agencies on Monday to remove DeepSeek, China’s best-known AI chatbot, from their computer systems and to stop buying it, along with any outside service built on top of it.
DHS says the models pose “multiple threat vectors,” meaning several separate ways things can go wrong. Using them “may result in the transfer of sensitive data to the PRC”—the People’s Republic of China—if government employees or vendors use them, and could produce “actionable intelligence on U.S. persons and/or government agencies.”
Deepseek is an open source model that can run locally or hosted by any provider, not just China based. For example, Perplexity runs its own servers located in the United States. That said, the developers host a version in servers located in China for those using Deepseek.com’s services.
The ban reaches past DeepSeek’s own app to third-party services developed using it.
A July DHS memo, made public Monday, had already told agencies to monitor traffic flowing in and out of government websites for DeepSeek-related risks. The Commerce Department and the Navy previously banned DeepSeek on government devices, and New York, Tennessee and Virginia have taken similar steps. The Chinese Embassy in Washington did not immediately comment.
DeepSeek, a Hangzhou-based startup, became a household name on Jan. 27, 2025, when its open-source model, built for under $5 million, knocked Nvidia’s stock down 16% and erased about $600 billion of the chipmaker’s value. U.S. tech as a whole lost an estimated $1 trillion that day, because Deepseek proved to be similarly capable than America’s best models while costing a fraction of the price, with the possibility of running for free on the appropriate infrastructure.
Italy’s data protection authority also ordered DeepSeek to block its chatbot days later, calling the company’s answers to its privacy questions “totally insufficient.” In April 2025, a House select committee on the Chinese Communist Party alleged that DeepSeek secretly sends American user data to the Chinese government..
The same committee said DeepSeek may have used about 60,000 Nvidia chips, including 20,000 restricted under U.S. export controls, the rules that bar selling the most advanced AI chips to China.
DeepSeek has kept shipping since: the preview of its V4-Pro model, released in April, is priced about 98% below OpenAI’s GPT-5.5 Pro and is free to download and modify under an MIT license, and this week it released an updated version of its V4.1-Flash model aimed at efficiency with big quality gains.
The notice lands in the middle of a wider federal push against Chinese technology as the Federal Communications Commission votes on October 29 on barring all Chinese labs from testing electronics for U.S. use.

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- JPMorgan launched JPM Coin on Ethereum for institutional clients, which can redeem the token for dollars at any time; it first launched on Coinbase's Base network in November 2025.
- The bank expects crypto firms to use the token for payments and financial institutions to use it to settle trades and post collateral, with only vetted counterparties allowed to hold it.
- Kinexys has handled over $4 trillion in transactions and about $7 billion a day, versus roughly $12 trillion a day across JPMorgan's payments business.
JPMorgan Chase is putting JPM Coin on Ethereum, which gives its biggest clients a way to move dollars in seconds on a Sunday night as easily as on a Tuesday morning.
A normal wire between banks only moves during business hours and can take days to land, which is why JPMorgan started experimenting with blockchain technology. The idea is using JPM Coin to cut that wait to seconds.
The token is a deposit token, so each unit stands for a dollar already sitting in a JPMorgan account, and the bank's site says clients can redeem it for dollars at any time with no lock-up. A stablecoin, by contrast, is a token pegged to the dollar by a private company that holds the reserves somewhere else.
Only vetted, approved counterparties can hold JPM Coin, so this is not a coin anyone can buy on an exchange.
JPMorgan first put the token on Base, a cheaper and faster network built on top of Ethereum and incubated by Coinbase, in November 2025. That followed months of testing with Mastercard and Coinbase, and holders can now move the token between the two networks.
In January, the bank also said it would bring JPM Coin to Canton Network, a privacy-focused blockchain built for financial markets. It has also issued two tokenized money-market funds on Ethereum, in December 2025 and May 2026, which are funds holding short-term debt that are represented as tokens.
Emma Landriault, global head of Kinexys Labs at JPMorgan's blockchain unit, pointed to the money and tokenized assets (traditional investments such as shares, debt and funds, issued as blockchain tokens) already circulating on Ethereum, where about $50 billion sits in applications, according to DefiLlama.
Crypto firms are expected to use the token for payments, while financial institutions can use it to pay for trades in tokenized assets or to post collateral, meaning a guarantee against a deal.
“We’ve clearly been in a year of further convergence between Wall Street and crypto,” Landriault told Bloomberg. Matthew Dawson, co-founder of Ethereum Institutional, called the move “a clear signal that institutional finance is moving onto public, verifiable infrastructure.”
The bank is also fighting for the same customers as stablecoin issuers. A consortium of more than 100 companies including Visa, Stripe, and Mastercard launched its own dollar stablecoin last month, while Kinexys co-head Naveen Mallela has said deposit tokens are “a compelling alternative” to stablecoins because they “can be yield-bearing,” meaning they can pay interest.
Kinexys, the unit behind the token, has handled more than $4 trillion in cumulative transactions and averages about $7 billion a day, against roughly $12 trillion a day across JPMorgan's wider payments business.
JPMorgan, Citigroup and other large banks plan to launch a shared 24/7 tokenized deposit network as early as the first half of 2027.

Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto license to support global expansion
The UK-based fintech will use the authorization to offer crypto services in additional international markets, though it has not disclosed specific countries or launch dates.
Revolut, a UK-based financial technology company and neobank, has received a cryptocurrency services license in Gibraltar, which it plans to use to expand its digital asset offerings into international markets beyond the UK and European Economic Area.
The Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) granted a Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) Provider license to Revolut Global Digital Assets Limited, a newly established subsidiary, according to a Monday announcement.
A Revolut spokesperson told Cointelegraph that the license will allow the company to offer crypto services in additional international markets, although specific countries and launch timelines have not been announced.
Revolut currently provides cryptocurrency services through Revolut Ltd in the UK and Revolut Digital Assets Europe Ltd across the European Economic Area, where its operations fall under the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA).
The fintech reports more than 80 million retail customers worldwide, including about 16 million cryptocurrency users, according to its announcement.
The Gibraltar license follows Revolut’s in-principle approval to offer crypto services in Dubai in July and preliminary conditional approval from US regulators in September to establish a national bank offering digital asset custody and crypto-related payment services.

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- An address first funded in September 2013 moved 411.45 BTC, worth about $33.4 million, to a new wallet on Sunday, its first outgoing transfer ever.
- The coins cost about $54,000 when Bitcoin traded near $130, and the transfer went to an unlabeled address, not an exchange.
- Galaxy tagged the address as one of 39,069 named in a New York lawsuit by “Noah Doe” seeking ownership of dormant wallets as abandoned property.
Another long-sleeping Bitcoin whale has stirred, and this one is named in a lawsuit claiming its coins were abandoned.
An address beginning with "13Coop" that had never sent a single coin since it was first funded on Sept. 11, 2013, moved 411.45 BTC, worth roughly $33.4 million, on Sunday, according to Galaxy Research. Arkham data shows the coins landed in a single new address, where they remain.
When the wallet was funded, Bitcoin traded around $130, according to Arkham, meaning the stash cost about $54,000. Galaxy put the holder’s average cost basis near $127 and the paper gain at more than 64,000%. It’s unclear whether the owner plans to sell, since the transfer went to an unlabeled address, not an exchange.
Galaxy tagged the sending address as “Noah Doe #970,” marking it as one of 39,069 dormant addresses named in a New York lawsuit filed this year by a pseudonymous plaintiff called Noah Doe and two Wyoming companies.
🏚️ 💤 Address awakened — dormant 13+ years — 411.45 BTC sent
This address had never sent coins (first funded 2013-09-11, 13.1y ago); it just spent 411.45 BTC ($33.44M) in block 972,036
Address: 13Coop8xFbYj9JR9WyF5EqzGa9GiZmxs7C
Coins moved: 411.45 BTC in 2 UTXOs — all held…
— Galaxy Research (@glxyresearch) October 18, 2026
The plaintiffs argue that the wallets, which hold about 3.8 million BTC, qualify as abandoned property under the state’s lost-and-found law, even though they hold none of the private keys.
Galaxy also flagged the address as one of those “dusted” in a 2025 campaign that sent tiny amounts of Bitcoin carrying embedded messages to dormant wallets, which Galaxy has described as groundwork for the abandonment claim. Arkham’s data shows a string of those dust deposits, some labeled as phishing.
Each move chips away at the lawsuit’s premise. Spending coins requires the private keys, which suggests at least some of the targeted wallets are anything but abandoned. Galaxy head of research Alex Thorn has said the pace of dormant “Noah Doe” coins moving onchain has been accelerating month over month.
The wallet joins a growing list of old coins on the move. Bitcoin’s oldest coins have been waking up at an unusual clip in 2026, according to Galaxy Research data.
Just a little over a week ago, a Satoshi-era wallet mined in 2010 moved for the first time in 16 years. In late September, about $161 million in decade-old Bitcoin was transferred over the course of roughly two weeks. And just last week, a whale moved a whopping $377 million after holding through every major market crash since 2020.

items.author: Mark Toon
items.content:
Stablecoin Development Corp (SDEV), a company that’s designed to essentially hold and stake governance token SKY, has seen its stock price rocket nearly 1,000% — and subsequently plummet 92% — in a matter of weeks.
Why it pumped and dumped so quickly isn’t clear.
Protos previously reported on SDEV and it’s subsequent almost tenfold increase in price, but since then the price has collapsed to under $0.90, with a current market cap of $45 million.
At the same time, a Substack going by Fugazi Research released an article questioning the foundations of Stablecoin Development Corp — including upcoming warrants that would dilute retail shareholders and flood the market with new, unpurchased shares.
Read more: Stablecoin Development Corp price pumps for no reason
Just over a week later on October 14, the stock was trading for under a dollar.
So, it’s likely that the short-seller report published by Fugazi contributed to the downfall of SDEV’s stock price — especially considering that other shortsellers were complaining about an inability to acquire shares to borrow in the days leading up to the collapse.
However, what still doesn’t make sense is why anyone valued the company at $500 million, even if only for a day.
Thirty-day MA way up
Protos was previously keeping an on eye on the 30-day moving average (MA) for SDEV, due to the fact that this price would benefit individuals and entities that may be exercising warrants shortly.
It’s true that the 30-day MA is significantly higher now than it was a month ago — nearly doubling, from an MA of $0.95 to over $1.75.
But if Tether has exercised or intends to exercise its warrants, which became eligible to be exercised on October 16, there have been no new filings recorded by the SEC documenting it nor any documents discussing new ownership percentages.
Protos will keep following SDEV and whether Tether exercise its warrants over the next few weeks.

Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal
The transaction would give Metaplanet access to US capital markets, where it plans to use preferred stock offerings to finance additional Bitcoin purchases.
Shareholders of Super League, a Nasdaq-listed gaming and digital media company, approved a deal that would give Japanese Bitcoin treasury firm Metaplanet a 93.7% ownership stake, paving the way for its expansion into US capital markets through a publicly traded Bitcoin treasury company.
According to a Monday announcement and filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), shareholders approved the issuance of as many as 435.9 million common shares under agreements involving Metaplanet and Evo Fund. Metaplanet will contribute 2,100 Bitcoin (BTC) and $2.5 million in cash in exchange for 44.86 million common shares, 100 shares of convertible perpetual preferred stock carrying governance rights and 10-year warrants for additional common stock.
The transaction would give Metaplanet control over the company, including the ability to designate a majority of its board and approve major corporate decisions. Metaplanet’s common shares will be subject to a five-year lock-up.
As part of the deal, Super League plans to rebrand as Superplanet and adopt the Nasdaq ticker SUPA, with a strategy focused on increasing its Bitcoin holdings per share.
Rather than relying primarily on debt, Superplanet intends to finance additional Bitcoin purchases through senior, non-convertible perpetual preferred shares. Metaplanet will also have the option to invest up to $210 million in junior preferred stock to provide additional financial support.
Source: Dylan LeClair, Metaplanet director of Bitcoin strategy
The deal comes as Metaplanet continues to expand its Bitcoin holdings. The company has accumulated 44,000 BTC, making it the second-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder behind Strategy, according to industry data.
Related: Metaplanet to issue $329M convertible bonds to pay debt, fund share buybacks
Metaplanet looks to US markets to finance Bitcoin purchases
The deal would enable Metaplanet to raise capital in US dollars through preferred stock offerings, complementing its existing yen-denominated financing in Japan.
In an Oct. 15 SEC filing, Super League said the US market for preferred securities issued by Bitcoin treasury companies has grown large enough to support new entrants. The proposed financing structure would provide another source of funding for Bitcoin purchases without relying primarily on conventional debt.
The expansion comes as Metaplanet revises its broader investment strategy. Earlier this month, the company proposed allocating up to 15% of its total assets for strategic investments to help finance Bitcoin purchases and dividend payments.

Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC
The Bitcoin treasury company added another 1,223 BTC after an earlier purchase pushed it past MARA Holdings, while continuing to expand its reserves through equity financing.
Bitcoin treasury company Strive purchased 4,045 Bitcoin for approximately $335 million last week, bringing its total holdings to 36,818 BTC as it continues to expand its cryptocurrency reserves through equity financing.
The company acquired the Bitcoin (BTC) between Oct. 12-16 at an average price of $82,803 per coin, including fees and expenses, according to a Monday filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission.
Strive is now the fourth-largest publicly traded corporate BTC holder, ahead of MARA Holdings, with reserves valued at approximately $3 billion, according to data from BitcoinTreasuries.net. MARA was reported to be selling some of its holdings, as Arkham tracked wallets linked to the miner depositing about $82 million worth of the crypto into Binance and Gate in recent days.
Strive’s Bitcoin holdings reached 36,818 BTC. Source: BitcoinTreasuries.NET
Strive also reported approximately $369 million in proceeds from warrant exercises on Oct. 12 and 13, resulting in the issuance of 13.7 million common shares. Its effective share count rose 12.4%, roughly matching the 12.3% increase in Bitcoin holdings and leaving BTC per share largely unchanged.
The latest acquisition follows a series of large Bitcoin purchases by the company, including a 3,311 purchase the previous week, when its holdings grew 11.2%, outpacing a 9.4% increase in its effective common share count.
Strive also announced the launch of SATS last week, a new preferred stock issue carrying a fixed 15% annual dividend, payable each business day beginning Nov. 9, subject to board approval. The company priced a $630 million offering of the new preferred shares last week, with proceeds potentially funding additional Bitcoin purchases.
Strive (ASST) shares were up around 7.7% at $25.95 in late-morning trading Monday, according to Yahoo Finance data.

items.content:
Bitcoin is rejected at $83K as US bond yields reverse higher with equities
Bitcoin price action failed to improve with equities as a sell wall at $83,000 kept BTC in a tight range.
Bitcoin (BTC) traded below $82,000 after Monday’s Wall Street open as crypto diverged from rising stocks and bond yields.
Key points:
- Bitcoin gave up early-week gains as ask liquidity amassed above $83,000 across exchanges.
- The Nasdaq Composite Index followed Asian equities higher, gaining 1.5% in the first hours of trading on Monday.
- US bond yields continued to move in lockstep with stocks, with the 10-year yield back at 5.13% ahead of major corporate earnings announcements.
Bitcoin treads water as stocks, bond yields rebound
Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD dipping to $81,678 on Bitstamp after reaching $83,062 earlier in the day.
BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Both Asia and US equities rallied to start the week, helping to recoup losses from the week prior as selling pressure on tech stocks eased. South Korea’s tech-heavy KOSPI Composite Index finished the day 1.76% higher at 5,768 points, while the Nasdaq Composite Index was up 1.5% at the time of writing.
Nasdaq Composite Index one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Continuing a pattern observed in recent weeks, US bond yields rose in lockstep with equities ahead of anticipated strong corporate earnings by tech giants. Several of these are due for release on Tuesday and Wednesday, including Meta, SpaceX and Tesla. The US 10-year and 30-year yields reached 5.13% and 5.46%, respectively.
US 10-year bond yield one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
In its latest analysis, trading company QCP Capital saw bond-market stability as key to Bitcoin upside momentum. It also warned that BTC could suffer from a repeat of last week’s tech-stock sell-off.
“Broader equity deleveraging dynamics could transmit to cryptocurrency markets and potentially threaten the $80,000 support level if sustained. Conversely, a sustained Treasury rally could provide support for risk assets, particularly if accompanied by declining real yields and a weaker US dollar,” it wrote.
$83,000 sellers keep BTC price in check
On lower time frames, Bitcoin price action encountered friction after ask liquidity thickened above $83,000 on exchange order books.
Related: Stocks rebound into key tech earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
Data from CoinGlass showed this wall of asks pressuring BTC/USD lower, while 24-hour cross-crypto liquidations totaled $335 million.
Crypto liquidation heatmap. Source: CoinGlass
Amid rangebound conditions, onchain analytics platform CryptoQuant showed Bitcoin whales reducing activity. The Binance whale ratio, which records the share of the 10 largest inflow transactions relative to total inflows, fell to 0.45 from 0.54 at the start of October.
“The decline in the Whale Ratio indicates that the proportion of large BTC deposit transactions relative to total exchange inflows is decreasing, potentially reflecting shifts in whales’ trading strategies and asset management activities,” CryptoQuant summarized.
Binance Bitcoin exchange whale ratio. Source: CryptoQuant

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- Bitcoin trades at $82,164, just above the a key support line, after touching $83,040 today and giving back part of the gain.
- Oil near $108, 3.7% inflation, and a 10-year yield above 5% keep rate-hike fears alive, while spot Bitcoin ETFs lost about $910 million in two weeks.
- Technical indicators on the charts suggest caution for traders in the near term.
Bitcoin continues to defy seasonal ‘Uptober” expectations, as macroeconomic factors weigh heavily on the digital asset.
Bitcoin is hovering around $82,000 on Monday, up about 1% on the day, after tagging $83,000 early and handing some of it back.
Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, trades near $108 a barrel after weekend attacks on Persian Gulf tankers and Russian crude facilities. Pricey oil raises the cost of fuel and freight, which feeds inflation. The consumer price index (CPI), what households pay, rose 3.7% in September from a year earlier, while the producer price index (PPI), what businesses pay, jumped 6.3%, the biggest annual rise since 2022.
That likely pushes the Federal Reserve toward raising interest rates, which makes borrowing costlier. Markets see roughly a 15% chance of a quarter-point hike next week. You can see it in Treasury yields, the return investors earn lending to the U.S. government: when hike bets rise, bond prices fall and yields climb. The 10-year sits at 5.08% and the 2-year at 4.72%, CNBC data shows.
A near risk-free 5% competes with stocks and crypto for the same money, and it raises the debt costs of the AI giants that borrowed heavily for data centers. Bitcoin trades with that risk basket, so AI selloffs tend to drag it down.
The pain was concentrated in companies paying for the AI buildout with borrowed money. The Nasdaq Composite fell more than 2% on Friday and closed its worst week since June, with AMD down 6% and Micron down 5.6% on the day. CoreWeave, a so-called “neocloud” that rents out AI computing power, lost about 24% over the week, and it funds much of its data center spending with debt and new share sales rather than cash flow.
Hotter inflation and higher yields make that kind of debt costlier to carry, so the stock selloff and the bond market are really the same story.
Bitcoin price: technical analysis
Bitcoin trades at $82,164 on the daily chart, up 0.18% in today’s forming candlestick, sitting right on the 0.236 Fibonacci retracement at $81,603. Fibonacci levels mark where pullbacks tend to pause, and 23.6% is the shallowest, so holding it keeps the climb from the $87,422 high intact. The bounce is weak, though: a week of small candle bodies says neither side is in control.
Bitcoin’s current price is also inside the $81,847 to $82,305 "golden zone" of the recent $80,365 to $84,246 swing, where buyers often show up.
The 50-day exponential moving average, or EMA, weights recent prices more heavily and sits at about $80,548, above the 200-day EMA at about $75,932, with current price above both. That formation, known as golden cross, reads bullish because short-term buyers are paying more than long-term holders.
The Average Directional Index, or ADX, measures trend strength, and currently reads 21.6. Below 25 means no firm trend and more false breakouts. The Relative Strength Index, or RSI, is at 49.3, basically dead neutral with neither bulls nor bears dominating the market.
So, without a clear trend, the Squeeze Momentum Indicator has been "on" for 13 days, meaning volatility is compressed like a spring. Momentum at -1.42 leans mildly down.
A daily close below $81,603 opens $81,196 and the 50-day EMA. Bulls need closes above $83,330 and $84,246, ideally with a rising ADX. The Fed meeting next week and major earnings calls (like Meta and Tesla) this week are the next catalysts to follow.

前第5大SOL财库公司激进转型清空SOL持仓，一个月前仍重申「SOL财库战略」

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，前身为 Sharps Technology 的 SkyAI 近期经历了一场激进的战略大转弯。该公司已将其持有的 Solana（SOL）储备全部清仓，以资助其股票和权证的回购计划，从而从曾经的第五大 Solana 财库公司变成了零持仓状态。

根据 SkyAI 周一发布的声明，截至 10 月 16 日，公司持有约 2.238 亿美元的现金，并已「完成所有 SOL 的出售」。在本次回购计划中，SkyAI 提出以每股或每权证 3 美元的价格回购 95% 的流通股。如果回购被全额认购，在扣除相关费用前，公司将剩余约 2250 万美元。此外，由于目前已不再持有 SOL，公司还取消了原定中要求 SOL 价格保持在 100 美元以上的回购条件。

这一清仓动作显得十分迅速且突然。就在 9 月 14 日，SkyAI 还重申了其 Solana 财库战略，并宣称持有超过 200 万枚 SOL。然而 10 月 11 日的回购公告披露其已卖出约 100 万枚 SOL，随后的 SEC 文件显示其剩余余额仅约 60 万枚。这种快速的抛售引发了持有 SkyAI 近 10% 股份的大股东 Bastion Trading 的强烈不满，后者呼吁进行独立审查，并明确表示不会按照当前提议的条件参与回购。Bastion 方面要求将回购价格提升至每股 3.5 美元，对内部人士施加限制，并将战略顾问的权证排除在回购之外。

尽管清空了加密资产，SkyAI 仍将其业务描述为「构建一个将 Solana 上的稳定币轨道与 AI 相结合的金融平台」，但周一的公告并未说明公司是否打算重建其 SOL 财库，也未提供该平台的任何最新进展。公司仅表示计划在回购完成后继续保持纳斯达克的上市地位。截至最新交易日，SkyAI（SKYA）股价当日上涨 4.5% 至 2.77 美元，年内累计涨幅达 35%。

- Chairman Tom Lee blamed recent crypto weakness on a broad risk-off shift—AI funding and safety fears, U.S.-Iran tensions, midterm jitters and rising bond yields—and called the dip a historically attractive risk-reward entry.
- Total holdings hit $15.1 billion, and Bitmine remains the top ETH treasury.
Bitmine Immersion Technologies kept its weekly Ethereum buying streak alive, adding 12,535 ETH worth about $30 million, even as a market-wide selloff battered crypto prices and the firm closed in on the end of its accumulation.
The NYSE-listed company said Monday its holdings now total 6,041,481 ETH, valued at roughly $14.3 billion at a reference price of $2,365 per coin. That represents 4.9% of Ethereum’s 122.1 million token supply, leaving Bitmine, by its own count, 99% of the way to its goal of owning 5% of the network, a target it calls the “Alchemy of 5%,” reached in just 15 months.
The purchase extends a run that hasn’t paused since Bitmine launched its treasury strategy on June 30, 2025, buying Ethereum every week since. Chairman Tom Lee has said the company is nearly finished stacking and will stop once it hits the 5% threshold. (Disclosure: Tom Lee is one of several investors in Dastan, Decrypt’s parent company.)
This latest buy lands with the firm underwater on paper, a consequence of accumulating much of its stash last year at higher prices, with ETH now trading well below its highs.
Lee pinned the recent weakness on a broad contraction in risk appetite, citing anxiety over AI funding and model safety, escalating U.S.-Iran tensions, midterm-election jitters, and rising global bond yields.
He argued that selloffs in AI and semiconductor stocks in markets like Korea and Taiwan, where crypto is widely held, spilled over into digital assets, and framed the dip as a historically attractive risk-reward entry when fundamentals stay strong.
Counting cash, other tokens and what it calls “moonshot” investments, Bitmine’s total holdings reached $15.1 billion as of Oct. 18, including 215 Bitcoin, $582 million in cash and marketable securities, a $180 million stake in Beast Industries and a $74 million position in Eightco Holdings, which it bills as a rare public proxy for indirect OpenAI exposure.
Bitmine remains the world’s largest Ethereum treasury and the second-largest crypto treasury overall, trailing only Michael Saylor’s Strategy, which holds about 848,250 BTC.
Strategy recently added another $22 million in Bitcoin while buying back preferred stock. Bitmine has 5,067,309 ETH, about 84% of its holdings, staked through its MAVAN platform, with projected annualized revenue of roughly $309 million.

items.content:
Embarrassing pictures of Hex founder Richard Heart sitting partially naked in an armchair have been shared by Turkish news outlet TGRT Haber as part of its reporting on a police operation that saw Heart arrested and $7 million siezed.
Heart, real name Richard James Schueler, was arrested last week in Istanbul in an operation coordinated by Turkey’s security agency (MİT), Istanbul’s Chief Public Prosecutor’s Office, the Financial Crimes Division, and Interpol.
During a series of raids across 15 locations in Beşiktaş, police also siezed six physical crypto wallets, 300 designer bags, 100 pieces of jewellery, four rifles, three pistols, and 1,400 rounds of ammunition.
Heart’s alleged wife, Alina Kara, and three bodyguards were also arrested.
It’s unclear exactly when the embarrassing photo was taken, but judging by the shocked look on his face, and the police reporting, it seems to have been taken mid police raid.
Read more: Richard Heart arrested in Turkey almost 2 years after Interpol red notice
Turkey’s Minister of Justice Akın Gürlek said on Saturday, “Turkey will not be a refuge for transnational crimes and fugitive suspects!” and added that Heart’s judicial proceedings are still ongoing.
Interpol and Finland want Richard Heart
An Interpol Red Notice on behalf of Finland was posted against Heart in December 2024 for alleged aggravated tax fraud involving hundreds of millions of euros in unpaid tax.
In 2023, the SEC also accused Heart of selling over $1 billion in unregistered securities, and misappropriating millions of dollars from his Hex, PulseChain, and PulseX crypto projects.
This case was referred to in Gürlek’s post, but the SEC dropped its case in 2025 after failing to establish legal jurisdiction.

⚡️德国储蓄银行正式进军加密交易领域，首批机构客户可通过App直接买卖加密资产

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，据德国储蓄银行与汇划银行协会（DSGV）向媒体确认，德国储蓄银行（Sparkassen）已于本周一正式进军加密货币交易领域，首批参与的机构客户现已能够通过其现有的官方 App 直接买卖比特币等数字资产。

此次推出的交易服务由储蓄银行的证券服务提供商 Dekabank 提供支持，并联合斯图加特证券交易所共同负责加密资产的托管。初期支持交易的币种涵盖了比特币、以太坊、瑞波币、Solana 以及 Polygon。在费用方面，该服务设定每笔订单仅收取 0.99 欧元的低廉手续费，且用户无需强制绑定传统的证券账户，此举明显是为了在定价上直接与 N26、Trade Republic 等新兴手机银行展开竞争。

在推广节奏上，该服务并未设定全国统一的启动日期，而是由各储蓄银行根据自身情况自主决定上线时间。DSGV 管理层成员 Joachim Schmalzl 表示，集团内部对此项业务的兴趣十分浓厚，预计每月将有 30 至 40 家机构陆续跟进，目标是到 2027 年上半年覆盖大部分有意向的储蓄银行。他强调，该产品主要面向希望自主买卖和托管加密资产的客户，储蓄银行不提供投资建议，也不打算在初期进行广泛的主动营销。

长期以来，由于加密货币的剧烈波动性，德国储蓄银行对其一直持审慎态度。Schmalzl 指出，此次决定入局是经过仔细权衡的结果，决定性因素在于客户的强劲需求以及欧洲目前已具备了可靠的监管框架，其目的是让有明确意愿的客户能够在受监管的合规环境中进行交易。不过，DSGV 在声明中依然保持了警惕的基调，重申加密货币属于「高度投机性资产」，客户在操作时会被明确提示价格剧烈波动及全额损失的风险。银行方面同时强调，对于大众长期的财富积累而言，传统的证券投资、储蓄计划与财务咨询依然是其核心业务。

【Jito Labs 联创：订单流拍卖导致 Solana 上抢跑及三明治攻击增多】

Foresight News 消息，Jito Labs 联合创始人 buffalu 发推表示，近几个月来，多个 Solana 生态参与者和应用向 Jito 反映，链上抢跑交易和新型三明治攻击有所增多，这一现象与客户端团队和验证者更多采用订单流拍卖（OFA）的时间相吻合。他认为，OFA 实际上是私有内存池，验证者将收到的用户交易交由第三方搜索者优先处理，所得收益由各方分成。据其估计，目前 Solana 上约 30% 至 40% 的质押量已参与某种形式的 OFA。buffalu 表示，OFA 提供方虽称设有 KYC 和防抢跑机制，但相关措施是否有效只能依赖信任，违规行为通常在事后才能发现，用户损失无法追回。他举例称，曾有 OFA 提供方因对旗下搜索者监管不力，导致多个应用遭受了持续数周的三明治攻击，受损用户未获赔偿。他呼吁验证者核查所用客户端是否会向第三方优先提供用户交易数据，质押者在选择委托对象时应同时考虑交易执行质量和收益率。Jito 曾于 2024 年 3 月因三明治攻击问题关闭其公共内存池服务。

比特币基础设施协议Echo Protocol宣布将逐步关停

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，比特币基础设施协议 Echo Protocol 在社交媒体上发文，宣布因业务调整将逐步终止协议运营。官方在公告中对社区、合作伙伴及用户的长期信任与支持表达了感谢，并承诺将透明、负责地完成后续清算工作。

目前，Echo 协议的各项核心业务已全面停止接受增量资金。借贷协议已停止新存款、新借款及利息计提，策略与 LSD 业务也停止了新存款和新质押。官方现已开放还款、提现及必要的资产清算通道，呼吁用户尽快采取行动：借贷用户需尽快偿还债务、释放抵押品并提取资产；策略和 LSD 用户应尽早发起退出与申领；持有 aBTC 的用户仍可继续使用 Aptos-to-B² 跨链桥进行赎回。

为确保清算有序进行，公告明确了关键的时间节点。所有未结清债务的借款人必须在 2026 年 11 月 14 日前完成还款，逾期未还的贷款将面临抵押品清算，所得资金将用于偿还出借人。2026 年 11 月 19 日 23:59（UTC）是用户进行还款、提现及解除质押的最终截止日期。此后，Echo 协议将正式停止运营，所有剩余头寸将进入最终的清算与结算流程，平台仅保留 Aptos-to-B² 跨链桥的赎回服务。由于 LSD 与 Strategy 资产依赖于底层质押/解除质押的请求时间，用户实际可申领的时间将受此因素影响。

【美国拟设立加密税务自愿披露计划，非故意申报错误者可减免罚款】

Foresight News 消息，据 Cointelegraph 报道，美国众议院法案《Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act》（H.R. 10357）第 502 条要求美国财政部在法案生效后 12 个月内设立数字资产自愿披露计划，允许纳税人通过提交修订申报表、补缴税款及利息，并缴纳计划规定的罚款，纠正过去的加密资产税务申报错误。纳税人一般需在该计划设立后 24 个月内提交修订申报表。该条款设有两档罚款标准：以伪证罪为担保、声明违规行为并非欺诈或故意的纳税人，若在计划设立后 12 个月内申报，每年欠税的前 25,000 美元部分罚款率为 0%，超出部分为 5%；未作此声明的纳税人，前 25,000 美元部分罚款率为 25%，超出部分为 40%，逾期申报罚款率将进一步提高。未作声明的纳税人基于合规披露信息，可免于被移送刑事追诉。该法案已于 2026 年 9 月 16 日以 38 票赞成、5 票反对获众议院筹款委员会通过，仍需经众议院、参议院表决及总统签署方可生效。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben
items.content:
Made an ‘honest’ mistake with crypto taxes? New bill offers way out
A proposed US bill would let crypto investors correct past tax reporting mistakes through a dedicated disclosure program, with reduced penalties for eligible taxpayers.
Crypto investors who failed to report trades in previous years may soon breathe a sigh of relief thanks to legislation currently advancing in the US Congress.
Section 502 of the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, H.R. 10357, would require the Treasury secretary to establish a Digital Asset Voluntary Disclosure Program within 12 months of the bill becoming law.
That would allow eligible taxpayers to correct any past digital asset tax violation by filing amended returns and paying the tax owed, along with interest and a program penalty.
The House Ways and Means Committee approved the bill by a 38-5 vote on Sept. 16, but it has not become law yet; it still has to pass the House and Senate and be signed by the president.
“It’s a big change that would help a lot of ordinary taxpayers, and it has gotten very little attention,” Andrew Gordon, executive director of Digital Asset Tax Action, tells Magazine.
A gap in the system
Crypto investors in the US are already grappling with the first filing season under the new 1099-DA broker reporting rules, which give the IRS greater visibility into crypto transactions.
Gordon says those rules should make reporting easier going forward, but they fail to address the years before coming into effect.
The House Ways and Means Committee approved the bill by a 38-5 vote. Source: Ways & Means
“A large share of investors didn’t report correctly over the years,” he says, and existing procedures don’t offer taxpayers who made “honest mistakes” a predictable way to resolve their liabilities.
Related: Greece plans 10% capital gains tax on cryptocurrencies
“Today, a crypto investor who learns they didn’t properly report their crypto or has not reported at all has no good way to fix it,” he says; investors can discover years later that they misunderstood the tax treatment of crypto-to-crypto trades or reporting activity across multiple platforms.
What taxpayers could get
The IRS’s existing Voluntary Disclosure Practice is aimed at taxpayers who willfully violated tax rules and face potential criminal exposure.
For taxpayers with errant reporting skills, they can currently correct their mistakes by filing amended returns, but the penalty treatment is not as predictable as provision 502’s proposed crypto-specific program.
Sharon Yip, a certified public accountant (CPA) and founder of Crypto Tax Advisors, says reporting errors among ordinary crypto investors are common.
In her firm’s experience, some clients did not report crypto because they believed no tax was due until they cashed out, while others relied on incomplete exchange records or incorrectly classified transactions.
“There is no standardized process that gives non-willful crypto investors predictable penalty treatment or a clear resolution,” Yip tells Magazine.
She says a crypto-specific program could “fill this gap” by providing a “defined correction period, reduced and predictable penalties and greater certainty for taxpayers who come forward voluntarily.”
What the bill would offer
Under Section 502, taxpayers would generally have to file amended returns within 24 months of the program being established, and the bill sets out two penalty tracks.
There are lower rates for taxpayers who certify under penalty of perjury that their violations were neither fraudulent nor willful. They would face a 0% penalty on the first $25,000 of tax deficiency per year and 5% on amounts above that, if they file within the first 12 months of the program.
For those who don’t certify, rates of 25% on the first $25,000 and 40% above it apply, with the rates increasing if taxpayers miss the initial window.
49% of crypto users understood selling crypto can be a taxable event. Source: Cointracker
There is also relief from specified civil penalties, and taxpayers who don’t certify are protected from criminal referrals based on information properly disclosed for the tax offenses covered by the provision.
Yip says taxpayers should check their transaction histories across exchanges and wallets to identify which years need correcting before assessing whether their mistakes were genuinely non-willful.
Because falsely certifying carries a penalty of perjury, she advises seeking professional guidance where taxpayers are unsure.
Section 502 could come as a welcome relief for many US crypto users; a 2026 report by CoinTracker and Coinbase found that only 49% correctly understood that selling crypto can be a taxable event.
Magazine: Crypto lending rises again… but have they solved the risks?

items.content:
Here’s what happened in crypto today
Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
Today in crypto, World Liberty’s stablecoin supply fell by over $400 million in two weeks, layer-1 blockchain Qubic halted its network after an attacker exploited weak wallet seeds to steal roughly $1.4 million from more than 1,400 accounts and Tether joined a funding round for enterprise AI agent infrastructure startup AIsa.
World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin sheds $400M in market cap
World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin has shed over $400 million in market capitalization over the past two weeks, driven by large redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain.
On Monday, CoinGecko data showed USD1’s market capitalization at about $4.02 billion, down from $4.43 billion on Oct. 6. That’s a decline of approximately $401 million, or 9.1%. World Liberty Financial’s proof-of-reserves dashboard separately showed approximately $4.01 billion in reserves.
The decline extends a period of concentrated redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain, according to blockchain research firm Onchain Benchmark. The research platform found that nearly $200 million in BNB Chain redemptions originated from a single unidentified address, although it could not establish who controlled the funds or why they were redeemed.
Despite the redemptions, USD1 maintained its dollar peg throughout the period examined by Onchain Benchmark, trading between $0.998 and $1.000.
The researchers found no evidence of a sustained depegging event, indicating that the decline in circulating supply was not accompanied by a significant loss of the token’s dollar value.
Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
Layer-1 blockchain network Qubic halted operations Sunday after an attacker reportedly exploited weakly generated wallet seeds to drain approximately $1.4 million from more than 1,400 accounts, according to the project.
In a statement on X, Qubic said the network was halted at tick 85,371,949, where it remains paused at the time of writing. Qubic said the vulnerability affected wallet seeds generated using any browser on an iPhone or iPad, Safari on a Mac until Oct. 18, 2026, or the Qubic iOS app before July 2025, leading to 2.94 trillion Qubit (QU) stolen.
“87.1% of the drained funds never left the Qubic network and remain frozen in place,” said Qubic. “The remaining 12.9% was sent to MEXC, whose team froze the receiving account within about an hour.”
The Qubic theft is the latest in a series of attacks tied to weak wallet seeds. In July, Coldcard disclosed that attackers had stolen funds from wallets whose seeds were weakened by a firmware bug. Similar flaws affected Trust Wallet’s browser extension and the Libbitcoin Explorer tool in 2023.
Tether backs AIsa as strategic investor, completing seed extension round
AIsa said it had completed its seed extension round, with Tether and HIVEN joining as strategic investors.
The round brings AIsa’s total funding to more than $9 million. The two new investors joined Alibaba, Tribe Capital, Sumitomo Corporation, Draper Associates, Saison Capital and other backers.
“Enterprise AI agents need trusted information, useful tools and a governed way to transact,” said Jordan Liu, founder and CEO of San Francisco-based AIsa, in a Friday statement. “Our vision is to build the infrastructure that enables agents to discover, access and pay for resources globally, while giving enterprises full control over permissions, spending and transactions. We are excited to welcome Tether and HIVEN as strategic investors as we accelerate the transition from AI assistants to autonomous, production-ready agents.”
Fragmented providers, integrations and billing systems make it difficult for enterprise AI agents to operate effectively in production and manage at scale, according to the statement.
AIsa addresses this by bringing resource discovery, access and transactions into one governed, usage-based network, the Trusted Resource and Transaction Network for Enterprise AI Agents. Its infrastructure connects enterprise agents to external data, AI search, models, APIs, software tools and industry services, combining governed access with usage metering, billing and settlement, the
statement said.

Foresight News 消息，CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 在 Bankless 播客中表示，CFTC 近期提出的 Reg CTX 规则若最终通过，交易所将可向零售用户提供加密现货的保证金、杠杆及融资交易，用户可将 ETH、SOL 等资产作为抵押品进行交易。保证金要求将由交易所与 CFTC 协商制定，与加密永续合约及期货市场保持一致，目前最高约为 7 倍，但并非硬性规定。他表示，希望在未来数月内完成 Reg CTX 的最终制定。另一项规则 Reg CAM 将设立新的「加密资产市场」类别，为仅提供现货杠杆交易的新交易所提供联邦层面的牌照选择，使其无需逐州申请牌照。谈及规则的持久性，Michael Selig 表示，对《CLARITY Act》未能提交总统签署感到失望，但 CFTC 拥有充分的权限，并将加以运用，目标是制定两党都支持、能够经受时间考验的规则。他还表示，CFTC 与 SEC 将继续协调监管，未来可能允许与投资合同相关的代币更广泛地交易。关于预测市场，他表示，由于各巡回法院判决存在分歧，且新泽西州已请求最高法院审理，此案很可能将由最高法院裁决。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
Public companies object to OKX-ICE’s tokenized stock plan
Nine public companies objected to having their shares offered in tokenized form by OKX and ICE, testing whether platforms can create blockchain-based markets without issuer consent.
Nine listed companies have formally objected to having their shares offered in tokenized form on the proposed tokenized stock platform backed by OKX and Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), the parent company of the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).
The companies included Cerebras Systems, AppLovin, Applied Digital, Rocket Lab, CoreWeave, Verizon Communications, Applied Optoelectronics, Broadcom and UnitedHealth Group, according to a Thursday notice by OKX and ICE.
The notice did not disclose the reason behind the objection. Under the Securities and Exchange Commission’s Sept. 17 innovation exemption announcement, tokenized venues must give issuers written notice and an opportunity to object before listing third-party tokenized stocks.
“Issuers aren’t objecting to the blockchain. They’re objecting to not knowing what happens to their price once it trades there,” Robin Nordnes, CEO of trading validation platform Raiku, told Cointelegraph. “On a public chain, the validator building the block sets the order. Until desks can measure their distance to that point, best execution is a promise, not a number.”
The objections highlight a potential hurdle for tokenized stocks and test whether crypto platforms can create blockchain-based markets for public company shares without issuer cooperation.
Cointelegraph has approached OKX for comment on the ramifications of the objection but had not received a response by the time of publication.
Tokenized stock offerings need more real-world data to address pricing discrepancy concerns
Companies need to see the “upside and a track record of efficient pricing,” Misha Putiatin, co-founder of collateral markets platform Symbiotic, told Cointelegraph, adding that more “real-world data would help everyone assess the benefits and risks.”
He said that additional institutional tokenization initiatives, such as the Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation’s (DTCC) tokenization services, could instill more confidence in tokenized offerings.
Related: Nasdaq-listed Tron sets up $200M ATM share offering to fuel TRX acquisitions
CoinShares’ senior research associate, Luke Nolan, said the objection does not amount to a rejection of tokenization generally, but mostly against being tokenized without consent. He told Cointelegraph:
“This veto also seems to be venue-specific, as in companies being able to say: no, I don’t want them offered on this venue, but I could permit/launch it somewhere else.”
Nolan said the concerns are valid, adding that market participants have previously taken advantage of specific market mechanics to cause “squeezes” or “short-term swings” in the underlying asset’s price.
Capital moving onchain during the past 30 days. Source: OnchainBenchmark
More than $754 million in capital has moved onchain during the past 30 days, pushing the total across stablecoins and tokenized assets to $320 billion, according to OnchainBenchmark.

· 美股三大股指期货涨跌不一，AI 板块反弹成主线。道指期货接近持平或微跌，标普 500 指数期货涨约 0.5%，纳指 100 指数期货涨约 1%。上周纳指周跌逾 4%、标普跌近 2%，为 6 月下旬以来最大单周跌幅，投资者持续关注 AI 投资回报及数据中心企业的债务与融资风险。

· 摩根大通将英特尔（INTC）评级上调至「中性」，盘前上涨约 4%。分析师认为，在 CEO Lip-Bu Tan 带领下，公司在核心计算市场及下一代制造执行有所改善，风险回报已更趋平衡。存储及半导体板块盘前普遍反弹。

items.author: Aaron Wise
items.content:
Today is the anniversary of Black Monday, 1987. However, despite countless traders getting spooked over the weekend by suggestions of a repeat performance, today is completely different.
For example, index futures pricing late yesterday evening indicated mildly higher prices for Dow contracts up 0.1% — a far cry from the Dow’s 22.6% plunge on October 19, 1987.
Despite little to no pricing evidence of an impending market crash, traders seemed to latch onto the idea of a bear market in AI stocks, enamored with a viral essay about a “stealth” bear market supposedly festering within otherwise bullish indices like the S&P 500.
Market commentators posted calls for a Black Monday, racking up millions of combined views.
In contrast to 1987, today’s market isn’t already in freefall. In August 1987, the Dow peaked at 2,722 and had lost about 17.5% by the Friday close before the crash.
Today’s Dow, however, is within 4.5% of its all-time high. The S&P 500 is similarly within 2% of a record high today.
The pace of declines prior to today is also bad news for doomsayers who think today will end in catastrophe.
In 1987, the Dow had already crashed more than 10% during the three sessions prior to Black Monday, whereas today’s S&P 500 hasn’t been crashing at all prior to two trading days ago.
Read more: KOSPI erases an entire year’s worth of South Korean GDP
No pre-crash, portfolio insurance, or other 1987-like features
Secondly, today’s market doesn’t have two mechanisms that allowed Black Monday of 1987: portfolio insurance selling and circuit breaker-free trading.
Portfolio insurance, a faddish type of pre-determined stop-losses for investment portfolios in the 1980s, sold futures mechanically during the Black Monday crash of 1987.
In fact, US President Ronald Reagan appointed the Brady Commission to investigate Black Monday, and the report blamed portfolio insurance as one of the primary sellers that Monday.
Moreover, stock exchanges in 1987 didn’t have modern circuit breakers. Modern stock exchanges, as opposed to Black Monday markets, will trigger a 15-minute pause in trading after a 7% S&P 500 slide.
In addition, a 20% decline will close US stock markets for the day.
Yes, it is literally impossible for the US stock market to repeat a Black Monday drop of 22.6% today, because S&P 500 declines of more than 20% cannot process on US stock exchanges within a single trading day.
In addition, today’s S&P 500 index isn’t even particularly overvalued in comparison to Black Monday of 1987.
Today’s index trades at an estimated 26 times trailing earnings — only modestly higher than the S&P’s 23.3 multiple at its 1987 peak.
Lastly, companies in today’s S&P 500 are growing earnings 29% annually as of their most recent quarter, on average, with FactSet estimating constituents are reporting their third consecutive quarter above 25%.
This contrasts with Black Monday of 1987 when companies had reported essentially flat earnings between −1% and +4% year-over-year across the three quarterly reports before the crash.

In brief
- Strategy bought 267 BTC for $22.1 million last week and repurchased $193.1 million of its STRC preferred stock, according to an SEC filing.
- Its board raised the cap on its digital credit securities repurchase program to $3 billion from $2 billion, leaving $1.16 billion available.
- The company funded the Bitcoin purchase mostly by selling MSTR common stock, while the STRC buybacks came from its cash reserves.
Strategy bought 267 BTC for $22.1 million last week and repurchased $193.1 million of its STRC preferred stock, the company said on Monday.
The Bitcoin treasury firm paid an average of $82,900 per coin, including fees, between October 12 and 18, according to an SEC filing. That compares with $86,194 a coin for the 250 BTC it bought the week before, Decrypt reported. Strategy now holds 848,517 BTC, acquired for a total of $64.02 billion at an average of $75,446 per coin.
Strategy has repurchased $193M of $STRC and acquired 267 $BTC. As of 10/18/26, we hold 848,517 BTC and $5.3B of USD Assets. We have also increased the size of our Digital Credit Securities Repurchase Program from $2.0B to $3.0B. $MSTRhttps://t.co/4o0bQBaTb0
— Strategy (@Strategy) October 19, 2026
The purchase is in line with last week's $21.5 million buy, and a fraction of the $142.7 million Strategy spent on Bitcoin in the last week of September.
Strategy co-founder Michael Saylor had hinted at the purchase in a tweet on Sunday, writing: "We found room for more orange."
Strategy paid for the purchase with $22 million raised by selling 140,872 shares of its MSTR common stock through its at-the-market offering program, plus $0.1 million of cash. It sold none of its preferred stock during the week.
The company bought back 1,938,780 shares of STRC, its variable-rate Stretch preferred stock, using $193.1 million of what it calls USD Cash, money set aside for general purposes including buying Bitcoin.
Strategy's board also raised the total authorized under its digital credit securities repurchase program, which covers its preferred stock, to $3 billion from $2 billion. Last week's buyback had left $354.8 million in the program; after this week's purchases and the increase, $1.16 billion remained available as of October 18. A separate program to buy back MSTR common stock has $1 billion left.
The company also used $45.5 million from its USD Reserve, which is meant to cover preferred dividends and interest on its debt, to pay dividends. As of October 18, the reserve held $4.83 billion and USD Cash $447.3 million, down from $4.88 billion and $640.5 million a week earlier.
Strategy and the MSCI rules
The repurchase extends a run of weekly STRC buybacks. Strategy bought back $192.4 million of the stock the previous week, and $176 million the week before that, as it bought $29 million in Bitcoin and posted a $21 billion third-quarter gain. In the last week of September, it repurchased $151.7 million of STRC as it took its holdings to a then-record 847,666 BTC.
The company is also facing possible removal from MSCI's widely tracked equity indexes. On October 15, the index provider finalized a rule that treats "non-operating companies," those whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset, as ineligible for its Global Investable Market Indexes from the close of November 30. MSCI will publish the list of affected companies on November 11.
Removal would force funds that track the indexes to sell the affected shares. Saylor had urged MSCI to drop what he called a "discriminatory" rule.

彭博社专访Multicoin：不跟风投资纯AI，相信自己在加密领域的优势

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，在众多加密风投机构纷纷将投资范围扩大至人工智能（AI）领域之际，管理着 27 亿美元资产的 Multicoin Capital 却选择「逆流而上」，坚守数字资产阵地。其普通合伙人兼风险投资联席主管 Spencer Applebaum 在近日接受彭博社采访时，详细阐述了公司这一战略背后的核心逻辑。

面对行业内因 AI 争夺资金而导致新基金融资困难的现状，Applebaum 声称：「我们相信我们在加密领域拥有优势，我们希望保持对这一领域的忠诚。」

Applebaum 表示，Paradigm 等竞争对手已经扩大了授权范围以涵盖 AI 和机器人技术，但 Multicoin 不会效仿。因为从未进行过纯粹 AI 投资的 Multicoin，如果在此时转向，将失去其在加密领域所拥有的优势。

Applebaum 强调，公司的过往业绩和深厚的人脉网络，使其成为加密企业家最先接触的投资者之一。

对于当前市场中热炒的「加密+AI」概念，Applebaum 更是直白地表达了他的质疑：「在很大程度上，人们是在寻找一个在加密和 AI 交汇处并不存在的问题。很多投资者都在试图强求。」

除了坚守阵地，Applebaum 还回应了外界关注的 2022 年基金部署速度放缓的问题。他将此归因于当年加密交易平台 FTX 倒闭后的市场环境：「在整个 2023 年，我们看到的种子轮融资大多是投后估值 3000 万美元左右、规模约 300 万美元的项目。当你要用一只 4.22 亿美元的基金去投这类型的轮次时，部署资金自然需要长得多的时间。」

此外，Applebaum 透露，Multicoin 对数字资产的承诺同样体现在其直接购买加密货币的对冲基金上。他确认，该基金最大的头寸是去中心化衍生品交易平台 Hyperliquid 相关的代币 HYPE，这些代币均通过公开市场买入。尽管他拒绝透露具体持仓规模，但他强调，Multicoin 通常会持有公开交易的资产数年，而不是几天或几周。

Strategy buys $22M in Bitcoin, repurchases $193M in STRC
Strategy added 267 Bitcoin to its holdings as it bought back 1.94 million STRC shares and boosted its preferred stock buyback program to $3 billion.
Michael Saylor’s Strategy, the world’s largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder, continued buying Bitcoin last week while spending nearly nine times as much repurchasing its preferred stock.
Strategy bought 267 Bitcoin for $22.1 million at an average price of $82,900 between Oct. 12 and Oct. 18, bringing its holdings to 848,517 BTC, according to a Monday filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
The company also repurchased 1.94 million shares of its Stretch (STRC) preferred stock for $193.1 million and increased its digital credit securities buyback authorization to $3 billion from $2 billion.
The latest transactions extend a trend of management spending more on preferred stock repurchases than Bitcoin purchases, even as Saylor expects a return to a Bitcoin bull market.
Strategy’s STRC buybacks continue to outpace Bitcoin purchases
Strategy funded its latest Bitcoin purchase primarily through $22 million in proceeds from selling 140,872 shares of its common stock, MSTR, while using existing cash for the STRC repurchases.
The company has spent $459.2 million repurchasing STRC shares so far in the fourth quarter, more than six times the $72.3 million it spent acquiring 851 Bitcoin over the same period.
Related: Strategy conditionally declares daily dividends as STRC hovers below $100
STRC is a variable-rate preferred stock designed to pay regular dividends. Strategy has previously said it intends to repurchase shares trading below their $100 stated value to help support the stock’s price.
The company reported a $4.83 billion USD Reserve to support preferred stock dividends and debt interest payments, alongside $447.3 million in separate USD Cash holdings.
Saylor sees Bitcoin returning to a bull market
The heavier spending on STRC buybacks comes as Saylor expressed optimism about Bitcoin’s outlook during a discussion at ParaFi Investor Day on Saturday.
“We’re moving back into a bull market,” Saylor said, pointing to Bitcoin’s recovery above its 200-day simple moving average, a widely followed indicator of longer-term price trends.
Saylor identified restrictive trade, foreign and monetary policies as headwinds for BTC, while highlighting growing bank adoption and the tokenization of traditional financial assets as potential drivers.
Ahead of Monday’s Nasdaq open, MSTR shares were trading more than 2.5% higher in premarket activity, according to Yahoo Finance. The shares closed Friday down about 9.6%, at $138.83 apiece. STRC shares also gained around 0.8% in premarket trading to $98.45, after falling 1.8% on Friday.

【HPC 致函美国 SEC，支持通过 Regulation Crypto Assets 并提出五项修改建议】

Foresight News 消息，Hyperliquid Policy Center（HPC）发推表示，已向美国 SEC 提交意见信，支持 SEC 于 2026 年 8 月提出的 Regulation Crypto Assets 提案，并敦促 SEC 予以通过。该提案拟允许初创项目在 4 年内通过代币发行募资最高 500 万美元，并允许项目在 12 个月内通过融资豁免募资最高 7500 万美元，同时新设安全港规则，用于确认代币何时不再与投资合同挂钩。HPC 提出五项建议：将 SEC 3 月发布的空投解释写入最终规则，明确领取空投时连接钱包、通过制裁筛查等步骤不构成支付对价；直接明确二级市场交易及链上协议等中介的法律地位，使依豁免发行的代币可自始自由交易；允许项目直接认证其代币从未与投资合同挂钩，使安全港无需项目默认此前存在投资合同即可使用，并将保护范围扩展至仍在开发中的项目；将 SEC 工作人员关于代币回购的指引纳入最终规则，统一「中心方」的定义，并区分程序化回购与自主决定的回购；使联邦优先适用的效力在项目满足安全港条件后继续保留，避免代币面临 50 多个司法辖区的注册要求。

⚡️Metaplanet获批控股纳斯达克上市公司SLE，成功实现在美上市布局

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，Metaplanet 创始人兼 CEO Simon Gerovich 宣布，Metaplanet 与美国超级联赛公司（Super League Enterprise, Inc.，纳斯达克代码：SLE）的交易已在该公司的股东大会上获得正式批准。此举标志着 Metaplanet 从一家比特币财库公司向全球比特币原生金融平台转型迈出了关键一步。

据悉，Metaplanet 向纳斯达克上市公司 Super League Enterprise（SLE）注入 2,100 枚比特币及 250 万美元现金，总价值约 1.346 亿美元，以换取控股权。作为交换，Metaplanet 获得 SLE 新发行的约 4486 万股普通股（每股 3 美元），以及优先股和认股权证。交易完成后，Metaplanet 将持有 SLE 约 95.7% 的已发行普通股，成为其控股股东。

据 Gerovich 介绍，在交易完成后，Superplanet 将作为 Metaplanet 在美国上市的比特币财库平台，这将使其能够直接接入美国资本市场，并获得更加敏捷、灵活的融资能力。

在战略布局上，结合 Metaplanet 在日本设立的 Metaplanet Securities，此次获批将使该公司在全球最重要的两大资本市场（美国和日本）拥有互补性平台。这不仅有利于其开展国际融资与资本配置，也将进一步推进其在比特币财库、金融服务、金融产品及资产管理等领域的业务拓展。

Gerovich 表示，这是 Metaplanet 长期增长道路上的新里程碑，公司未来将继续向外界更新该交易在交割完成方面的最新进展。

items.content:
Morning Minute is a daily newsletter written by Tyler Warner. The analysis and opinions expressed are his own and do not necessarily reflect those of Decrypt. And check out our daily news show 'FOMO HOUR' covering all of the top stories and market action.
GM!
Today’s top news:
- Crypto majors rebound despite Black Monday fears; BTC at $82k
- Bitcoin ETFs see $228M in net outflows this past week; ETH ETFs lost $320M
- Circle plans to expand into 40 emerging market countries
- Papertrade leads onchain protocols in revenue on week with $30M
- Trenches index hits “cold” for first time since April
📈 Crypto Rebounds as Black Monday Looms
Thirty-nine years ago today, the Dow fell 22.6% in a single session. Nobody saw it coming, and the notorious “Black Monday” turned into trading history.
Crypto enters that anniversary bruised but not broken. Bitcoin sits at $82,161, down just 1.4% on the week and actually up about 1% over the last 30 days. That’s the good news and it’s nearly the only good news.
Everything else got hit harder. Ethereum fell 5.3% to $2,415. BNB dropped 3.3%, Solana 6.2%, XRP 7.2%, Dogecoin 9.4%, Hyperliquid 8.6%, Zcash 13.2%. Across the majors, the average decline outside Bitcoin was 7.5%—roughly five times what BTC gave up.
Further out it gets ugly. Starknet lost 45% on the week, LayerZero 24%, Pump.fun 22%, Ethena 20%, Fetch 20%, Midnight 19%, Canton 18%, Jupiter 18%, Filecoin 17%, Raydium 18%. The top twelve weekly losers averaged losses of more than 20%. And all of this happened in just seven days.
The ETFs bled out as well. Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $228.4 million across the week, Ethereum ETFs $320.1 million, for a combined $548.5 million. For October, the two complexes have now bled $1.86 billion. Ethereum’s situation is the more fragile one: $14.5 billion in net assets against $12.9 billion of cumulative inflows leaves barely $1.6 billion of cushion before the entire product line is underwater on a mark-to-market basis.
But for context, what turned a bad Friday into Black Monday back then was automated selling feeding automated selling, with no circuit breakers to interrupt it. Equities have those now, and Korea’s Kospi actually tripped one last week. Crypto has none. It trades through the weekend, through the open, through everything, and we already watched what that looks like on October 10, 2025 when the liquidation cascade repriced the whole market in hours.
The setup today is the opposite of a cascade. Slow bleed, orderly exits, Bitcoin holding while the tail gets cut off—and over the weekend, a modest bid returning across the board. And there is broad concern for a “Black Monday” occurring today. Which very likely in itself means it won’t happen. Crashes don’t occur when everyone is expecting them and ready with cash on the sidelines.
The bears may want a Black Monday, but they are very unlikely to get it. At least today…
🌎 Macro Crypto and Markets
- Crypto majors are flat on the day but rebounding from a Sunday selloff; BTC even at $82.4k; ETH even at $2,422; SOL +1% at $105; HYPE even at $79; ZEC +1% at $1,146
- Top alt movers include RAY (+8%), ARB (+8%), VVV (+6%) and PEPE (+6%)
- Oil +4% at $101; Gold +0.4% at $4,200
- Stock futures are green after news of a Putin peace summit incoming; DOW -0.1%, Nasdaq +1.1%
- Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo and Morgan Stanley all told third-quarter earnings calls that tokenization is a growth opportunity rather than a threat, with David Solomon comparing it to the shift to electronic stock trading and Wells Fargo revealing its tokenized-deposit payments system is already in production
- Nine companies including Broadcom, Verizon and UnitedHealth have objected to having their shares traded on the OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, an early test of the SEC’s five-year Innovation Exemption
- Crypto super PAC Fairshake has now spent about $46.66 million trying to keep Sherrod Brown out of the Senate, adding a $5.2 million media buy and a second $1.95 million buy this month in Ohio
- A federal judge refused to let the CFTC walk away from its own $5 million settlement with Gemini, rejecting a joint request from the agency and the exchange to vacate the 2025 consent order and ruling that shifting enforcement priorities and internal misconduct allegations aren’t enough to undo a deal Gemini signed voluntarily three weeks before trial
- Circle plans to expand into roughly 40 emerging and developing countries, with CEO Jeremy Allaire telling the IMF and World Bank meetings in Bangkok that organic demand across Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East is pulling stablecoins out of the early-adopter phase
- Nine organizations launched the Quantum Alliance, an open standards body modeled on the IETF
Corporate Treasuries & ETFs
- The Bitcoin ETFs saw $228M in net outflows this past week; the ETH ETFs lost $320M in net outflows
Meme Coin Tracker
- Meme leaders were mixed; DOGE even, SHIB even, PEPE +5%, PENGU +1%, TRUMP -2%, SPX -4%, BONK -1%
- Robinhood chain leaders fell over the weekend; Pons -20% to $176M; AI -30% at $80M; Cashcat -10% at $105M; Orbio +10%, Boner +13% and Torch +78% led top movers
- Solana top movers included Dacity +150%, Weft +550% and Pierre +29x
💰 Token, Airdrop & Protocol Tracker
- Papertrade led onchain protocols in revenue on the week with $30.56M, followed by Hyperliquid at $16.4M and Pump.fun at $14.26M
- BNB Chain burned about 1.646 million BNB worth roughly $1 billion in its 37th quarterly Auto-Burn, destroying 1.65% of the token’s eventual 100 million supply target in a single quarter
- The unofficial trenches index hit “cold” for the first time since April, after reaching Euphoric conditions in August-September
🚚 What is happening in NFTs?

- Hypurr (+24%) and Checks (+15%) led top movers

MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash：每百万Token最低0.15美元，23日开源

动察 Beating AI 快讯，MiniMax 正式发布 M3.1 Flash，确认此前爆红的匿名模型 Space Bunny（太空兔）就是它的早期版本。Space Bunny 于 9 月下旬登陆 OpenRouter 和 OpenCode，累计调用量突破 200 万亿 Token，曾登顶两大平台的日调用榜。此后 MiniMax 于 9 月 27 日推出 M3.1 Flash Preview，如今正式公布完整跑分和 API 价格。

MiniMax 公布的测试中，M3.1 Flash 在办公自动化评测 Automation-Bench 上获得 62.2%，超过 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的 60.5% 和 Opus 5 的 50.3%。DeepSWE 编程测试得分 73.7%，接近 Opus 5 的 74.0%；视觉推理 BabyVision 达到 91.0%。不过，在电脑操作测试 OSWorld 中，它的 61.7% 仍落后于 Opus 5 的 70.6%。

items.author: Ryan Gladwin
items.content:
In brief
- Police in Amsterdam, Netherlands seized a server belonging to an anti-fascist group Autistici/Inventati (A/I), following a request from U.S. authorities.
- The U.S. designated the group as a "Specially Designated Global Terrorist" in August, claiming that it offered digital infrastructure to "far-left militants."
- A privacy advocate slams the politically motivated seizure as a "terrifying precedent," while a legal expert questions if the Dutch considered their legal right to refuse.
A Dutch-based server belonging to an anti-fascist political group was seized by police in Amsterdam last week. It followed a request from U.S. authorities, the NL Times reported Saturday, after the Trump administration designated the group as a "global terrorist" organization.
The seized server belonged to Italian internet service provider Autistici/Inventati (A/I), an anti-capitalist and anti-fascist group which offered free email and web-hosting services for organizations and activists. Police seized the server from a data center in Amsterdam's eastern district, and Dutch authorities are now handing its data over to the U.S.
Privacy advocate Harry Halpin told Decrypt that "politically motivated server seizures" set a "terrifying precedent." And one legal expert questioned whether the Dutch considered their legal right to refuse.
Halpin, CEO of privacy infrastructure firm Nym, told Decrypt, argued that the targeting of Autistici/Inventati servers by the Trump administration was "due to their political beliefs," adding that, "The fact that the Dutch authorities co-operated with them to shut down a server means that the Netherlands is nothing more than a colony of the United States."
The U.S. designated Autistici/Inventati as a "Specially Designated Global Terrorist" in August, claiming that it operates the "digital infrastructure for violent Antifa cells and other far-left militants."
The designation prevents U.S.-based people and organizations from doing business with them. In turn, Autistici/Inventati disbanded as its users and donors faced potential repercussions.
One legal expert said the designation has no standing in the Netherlands and that another legal power was exercised.
"An FBI agent in Amsterdam has roughly the powers of a tourist," Yuriy Brisov, lawyer and partner at Digital & Analogue Partners, told Decrypt. "So states ask each other permission. For the United States and the EU states, the rulebook for asking is a Mutual Legal Assistance Treaty, or MLAT, signed in The Hague in 1981."
Brisov explained that everything is done "under Dutch law, by Dutch officers, with Dutch powers," but entirely at the request of the U.S. For that reason, he said, Dutch authorities seized the server and not the U.S.
Prosecutors operate on a “trust principle,” the legal expert told Decrypt, meaning they don’t assess whether the seizure is proportionate or whether the U.S. investigation actually needs the material.
However, Brisov said, the Dutch could choose to refuse the request if it "harms its essential interests, concerns a political offence, or amounts to double jeopardy." Seizure is also only allowed if the alleged conduct is a crime in both countries carrying more than a year in prison.
It is important to note that designating a group as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist doesn't require a conviction or a court to hear the case, Brisov added, and neither the Dutch government nor the European Union followed the U.S. designation.
"Here is the Dutch problem: Washington's label underpins the request, and the Netherlands does not share it," Brisov told Decrypt, questioning whether "anyone in The Hague asked the political-offence question" that Dutch law reserves for Minister of Justice and Security David van Weel personally. "Internet hosts are not normally liable for what their users do," Brisov noted, adding that the rule is written into both U.S. law and EU law through the Digital Services Act.
Halpin told Decrypt that the request should have been scrutinized due to its political nature.
"Any country that believes in sovereignty should push back against politically motivated server seizures," he said. "This shows that only a multi-jurisdictional setup with true decentralization, as attempted by many blockchain projects, is the only way to resist nation-state-level attacks on digital infrastructure."

items.content:
World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin sheds $400M in market cap in two weeks
World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin saw its market cap decrease more than $400 million over two weeks of large redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain.
World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin has shed over $400 million in market capitalization over the past two weeks, driven by large redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain.
On Monday, CoinGecko data showed USD1’s market capitalization at about $4.02 billion, down from $4.43 billion on Oct. 6. That’s a decline of approximately $401 million, or 9.1%. World Liberty Financial’s proof-of-reserves dashboard separately showed approximately $4.01 billion in reserves.
The decline extends a period of concentrated redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain, according to blockchain research firm Onchain Benchmark. The research platform found that nearly $200 million in BNB Chain redemptions originated from a single unidentified address, although they could not establish who controlled the funds or why they were redeemed.
Despite the redemptions, USD1 maintained its dollar peg throughout the period examined by Onchain Benchmark, trading between $0.998 and $1.000. Onchain Benchmark found no evidence of a sustained depegging event, indicating that the decline in circulating supply was not accompanied by a significant loss of the token’s dollar value.
USD1 supply decline outpaces major stablecoins on Ethereum
According to Onchain Benchmark, Ethereum accounted for $184.60 million in net USD1 redemptions across 63 token burns between Oct. 6 and Oct. 15. BNB Chain recorded $200.43 million across 12 burns.
On Ethereum, more than 99% of tokens sent for redemption passed through a wallet labeled BitGo, USD1’s current issuer and custodian, while the BNB Chain transfers from the unidentified address were made in batches of $30 million to $50 million.
Related: France advances stablecoin tax, eyes self-custodial wallets and exit tax proposals
The reductions were not offset by new issuance on Solana, where USD1 supply remained unchanged at about $1.42 billion during the nine days reviewed by Onchain Benchmark.
“The next tests come with the change of issuer. When World Liberty’s trust company opens, it will take on a token whose size depends on the decisions of a few large holders, under a charter whose legal footing is being argued in court,” Onchain Benchmark said. “Whether fresh mints on Solana, or anywhere else, rebuild the total, or October marks the size USD1 carries into its new issuer, is the question the next weeks of supply data will answer.”
Transfers between Ethereum and BNB Chain totaled less than $1 million, according to the report, suggesting the missing supply wasn’t simply shifted between those networks.
USD1’s supply contraction on Ethereum was steeper than that of several other US dollar-denominated stablecoins between Oct. 6 and Oct. 15. USD1 supply on the network fell 11.45%, compared with declines of 4.93% for USDe, 2.18% for USDC and 0.76% for circulating USDT.

⚡️慢雾发布DarkSword木马分析报告：公开代码被武器化，iOS加密钱包面临威胁

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 19 日，安全机构 SlowMist（慢雾）发布了一份关于 DarkSword 木马后端及 iOS 攻击链的深度威胁情报报告。报告追踪了该攻击基础设施的演进过程，并揭示了其针对加密资产用户的高度危险性。

据慢雾分析，自 2026 年 3 月相关漏洞利用代码公开后，DarkSword-PROV2 于 7 月现身 GitHub，其攻击基础设施在 9 月下旬被观测到已上线运行。慢雾团队不仅追踪了其在线基础设施，还将其管理面板与公开的 GitHub 仓库进行了关联，并拆解了漏洞利用代码、投递链及攻陷后的利用能力。报告指出了该攻击框架的几个关键发现：

· 高度自动化的完整攻击流水线，集成了漏洞投递、设备与数据收集、数据窃取以及加密钱包资金归集功能。

· 广泛且深入的数据窃取能力，该工具包不仅针对钥匙串（Keychain）、文件和信息，还专门针对加密钱包数据，具备解密钱包数据和归集资金的能力。

· 尽管该工具包宣称支持 iOS 13 及更高版本，但代码分析证实，其实际有效的漏洞利用窗口集中在 iOS 18.6–18.7.2 以及 iOS 26.0–26.1 两个版本区间。

· 公开的漏洞组件已被武器化并整合进可部署的攻击框架中，这极大地降低了发起复杂 iOS 攻击的门槛。

针对此威胁，慢雾给出了明确的安全建议。用户应保持 iOS 系统更新，并避免点击不可信链接，因为仅在 Safari 浏览器中打开恶意页面就可能触发漏洞。如果设备曾访问过可疑落地页，用户应直接将助记词和私钥视为已泄露，必须使用从未访问过该页面的干净设备创建新钱包并转移资产。此外，用户还需全面检查各链上的异常交易与代币授权，并立即撤销不必要的授权（Revoke）。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372583

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- World, the identity project co-founded by Sam Altman, has launched World ID for banking and finance to help institutions confirm that real humans are behind transactions.
- Bain Capital, Pantera Capital, VanEck Funds, OpenExchange and Outtake are design partners, World said, pointing to forecasts of rising AI-enabled fraud.
- The project's iris-scanning Orbs have drawn regulatory action in countries including Spain, Kenya, Brazil and Hong Kong over biometric data concerns.
World co-founder Alex Blania has unveiled World ID for banking and finance, a suite of tools that lets financial institutions confirm a real person is behind transactions, trades and customer requests, the company said on Sunday.
Bain Capital, OpenExchange, Outtake, Pantera Capital and VanEck Funds are initial design partners, according to World.
The offering is built on three cryptographic proofs available through the World ID app. Proof of Human establishes that someone is a real and unique person through a one-time visit to one of World's Orb devices. Proof of Presence uses a selfie liveness check on a phone, while Proof of Attributes confirms details such as nationality or age from a government ID, revealing only the requested information.
Banks could use the proofs to require a verified human to approve ACH and wire transfers, or to recover an account, without collecting documents or storing other personal data, World said. AgentKit, a developer toolkit still in beta, lets users delegate certain proofs to AI agents so they can transact on a person's behalf.
The suite also includes World ID for Zoom, which builds on the project's earlier integrations with Zoom and Tinder. Participants verified at one of the project’s Orb devices get a "Human Badge" on their video tile after a live selfie check, and hosts will soon be able to require verification in the waiting room before a call.
World pointed to the case of an employee at engineering firm Arup who wired about $25.6 million in early 2024 after a video call in which every other participant was a deepfake. Deloitte forecasts that AI-enabled fraud losses in the U.S. could reach $40 billion by 2027, up from $12.3 billion in 2023, the company noted.
More than 18 million people hold a Proof of Human ID, according to World, with the World Foundation raising $52.5 million this year to scale the network.
In 2024, an employee at engineering firm Arup transferred $25.6 million after joining a video call where every other participant was a deepfake. Since then, AI has advanced significantly and is making impersonation increasingly convincing, causing challenges for financial… pic.twitter.com/J06gnULw8H
— World (@worldnetwork) October 19, 2026
World and privacy regulators
World's iris-scanning model has faced pushback from regulators around the world over its handling of biometric data.
Hong Kong's privacy watchdog ordered the project to stop its iris-scanning operations in 2024, while later that year South Korea's privacy regulator fined the project $830,000. That December, Spain's data protection agency told it to delete all iris scan data.
Last year, a Kenyan court ordered it to delete biometric user data, and Brazil's data protection authority denied its appeal against a ban.
