items.content:
Chinese suspect in $75M international crime network arrested in Bangkok
Police alleged the suspect was involved in cryptocurrency and foreign-currency exchanges for criminal groups across more than 133 accounts.
Thai police arrested a 37-year-old Chinese man wanted by authorities in China for alleged involvement in an international crime network and money laundering.
Investigators said the network handled more than 500 million yuan ($75 million) in transactions, Thai media Khaosod English reported in a post on X on Saturday.
Police alleged the suspect was involved in cryptocurrency and foreign-currency exchanges for criminal groups across more than 133 accounts.
They also claimed that he was involved in arranging visas for members of international crime groups linked to other money-laundering cases.
Investigators said he attempted to evade arrest by using forged documents to report his residence and changing vehicle registration plates before police found him in a luxury house in Bangkok.
His Thai visa had expired more than three years ago, so he will face legal proceedings before authorities coordinate his return to China to face the outstanding warrant.
Related: FinCEN ties $13B in crypto scams to non-US operations
Cointelegraph reported in June that crypto exchange Coinbase froze more than $3 million in cryptocurrency tied to a global operation targeting cyber-enabled crypto scam networks in Southeast Asia.
The operation was part of Disruption Week, led by the US Department of Justice’s Scam Center Strike Force, which brought together government entities and private industries to tackle crypto fraud targeting Americans.
The operation also involved Meta, Microsoft and Starlink, which worked together to take down servers and other hosting infrastructure linked to scam networks and disrupt criminal activity across more than 1.4 million social media and email accounts, leading to several arrests by the Royal Thai Police Anti-Cyber Scam Center.

⚡️Saylor批MSCI对数字资产带有偏见，称Strategy属经营性公司

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 18 日，Strategy 创始人 Michael Saylor 近日在彭博社节目中表示，MSCI 拟将 Strategy 等公司排除出全球股指的立场令人失望。其认为，将石油、天然气、土地与机械视为资本，却不把比特币视为资本，是在施加偏见性价值判断，并像未注册投资顾问一样行事。此次剔除对 Strategy 影响有限，但希望 MSCI 重新考虑。

Saylor 强调 Strategy 是经营性公司，产品是「数字信贷」，与银行、保险公司同属金融经营企业，并非控股公司。此前 MSCI 已敲定将「非经营性公司」剔除出全球可投资市场指数的规则，拟于 11 月 30 日收盘后生效，最终受影响名单将于 11 月 11 日公布。

美国检方打击跨国加密诈骗网络，涉嫌欺诈金额达数千万美元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 18 日，据彭博社报道，美国纽约布鲁克林地区检察官办公室虚拟货币部门负责人 Alona Katz 在 FBI 协助下，对一个从东欧运作的跨国加密诈骗网络展开打击，对其控制的逾 240 个诈骗网站及 112 台服务器实施查封和运行干扰。该网络曾骗取布鲁克林居民数千万美元，此次行动横跨三个时区，但未有人员被捕。

该团伙主要通过 Facebook 等社交平台接触俄语用户，自称是在美国通过交易获得成功的移民，诱导受害者先投入数百美元，再展示虚假盈利，鼓励持续追加资金。诈骗者有时允许小额提现，以营造可信假象；待受害者要求提取大额资金时，则索要高额费用或直接失联。

截至 10 月初，该团队正办理向布鲁克林俄语社区诈骗案受害者返还约 30 万美元的工作。报道援引 FBI 数据称，2025 年美国报告的加密货币诈骗损失达 114 亿美元，约为三年前的 3 倍。

分析师：比特币MVRV百分位跌至30以下，仍符合积累区间特征

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 18 日，加密分析师 Darkfost 发文表示，比特币在 87,000 美元附近受阻后，MVRV 百分位重新跌至 30 以下，再次进入市场投降后的过渡阶段。他认为，当前估值仍符合积累区间的特征。

Darkfost 解释，MVRV 用于比较比特币市值与已实现市值，后者以每枚 BTC 最近一次链上移动时的价格计算。他采用的方法并非仅观察 MVRV 原始数值，而是衡量当前数值在历史演变中的相对位置，以减少比特币结构性变化及市场周期对指标解读的影响，并将其置于当前市场环境中分析。

他指出，比特币历史上仅约 25% 的时间处于当前这一估值水平。虽然目前已离开过去始终与市场低点重合的极端低估区间，但仍符合历史积累区间的特征。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372411

Tether backs AIsa as strategic investor, completing seed extension round
The round brings AIsa’s total funding to more than $9 million.
AIsa said it had completed its seed extension round, with Tether and HIVEN joining as strategic investors.
The round brings AIsa’s total funding to more than $9 million. The two new investors joined Alibaba, Tribe Capital, Sumitomo Corporation, Draper Associates, Saison Capital and other backers.
“Enterprise AI agents need trusted information, useful tools and a governed way to transact,” said Jordan Liu, founder and CEO of San Francisco-based AIsa, in a Friday statement. “Our vision is to build the infrastructure that enables agents to discover, access and pay for resources globally, while giving enterprises full control over permissions, spending and transactions. We are excited to welcome Tether and HIVEN as strategic investors as we accelerate the transition from AI assistants to autonomous, production-ready agents.”
Fragmented providers, integrations and billing systems make it difficult for enterprise AI agents to operate effectively in production and manage at scale, according to the statement.
AIsa addresses this by bringing resource discovery, access and transactions into one governed, usage-based network, the Trusted Resource and Transaction Network for Enterprise AI Agents. Its infrastructure connects enterprise agents to external data, AI search, models, APIs, software tools and industry services, combining governed access with usage metering, billing and settlement, the
statement said.
Cointelegraph reported on July 31 that stablecoin issuer Tether generated another multibillion-dollar quarter as income from its US Treasury portfolio continued to bolster earnings.
Tether reported a net operating profit of $1.5 billion for the second quarter, driven primarily by interest earned on US Treasury holdings and repurchase agreements, or short-term loans backed by government securities.

items.content:
Reason让Claude Code和Codex跨电脑派活：能互相对话，却还不能自动防代码冲突

动察 Beating AI 快讯，YC 孵化的 AI 编程公司 Reason 推出 Reason Network，让 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等不同厂商的 Agent 跨电脑直接交流、分配任务。比如，你可以让 Grok Bot 给自己电脑上的 Claude Code 派活，再让同事电脑上的 Codex 检查代码。Agent 之间直接收发消息，不用人类反复转述。

它的核心是一张实时更新的 Agent 通讯录。开发者可以看到团队里有哪些 Agent 在线、正在修改哪个仓库、使用什么分支，以及当前忙什么。Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 可以在现有会话中直接收到消息，不必新开聊天。每台电脑运行一个轻量后台程序，同一局域网内可以直接通信。跨网络则优先建立点对点连接，失败时通过加密中继传递消息。

不过，Reason 宣传的避免代码冲突，目前还没有完全实现。GitHub 设计文档显示，自动检测多个 Agent 同时修改同一文件的功能尚未开发。现阶段主要靠共享工作状态，让 Agent 主动协调，不能自动阻止代码覆盖。

Reason Network 的底层通信引擎使用 Rust 开发，源自已有开源项目 tincan，采用 MIT 或 Apache 2.0 许可证。

观点：美股正经历「隐性熊市」，若宏观压力缓解或带来历史性机会

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 18 日，The Kobeissi Letter 发文表示，美股正呈现「牛市中的隐性熊市」：标普 500 指数虽距历史高点仅约 2%，但多数成分股已出现明显回撤。该机构认为，宏观压力压低了股票估值，而支撑指数上涨的大型科技公司仍具备盈利增长基础。84% 的标普 500 成分股较历史高点回撤至少 10%，59% 回撤至少 20%，41% 回撤超过 30%，17% 回撤超过 50%，指数上涨则高度集中于少数公司。

该机构指出，市场的利率预期已发生显著转变。年初投资者预计美联储 2026 年至少降息三次、合计 75 个基点；目前美联储已加息一次，市场还预计到 2027 年 6 月再加息三次。在油价超过 100 美元、通胀接近 4% 的背景下，标普 500 仍维持在历史高点附近。

其看多依据之一是盈利增长。标普 500 在 2026 年第二季度的综合盈利增长率达 52%，为 2021 年第二季度以来最高。过去 12 个月，英伟达股价上涨 21%，市盈率却下降 46%；目前预期市盈率约 24 倍，接近标普 500 的 22 倍。该机构认为，推动指数上涨的大型科技股仍计入了较大的宏观折价，当前市场集中度对标普 500 偏利好，或至少暂未构成问题。

对于后市，该机构认为，若伊朗战争出现结束迹象、全球能源危机缓解，能源价格和通胀预期可能随之回落，美联储也可能转向更鸽派立场，进而推动科技股估值折价消退、上涨扩散至更多股票。其同时提出，如果伊朗战争从未发生，标普 500 可能已处于 9000 点以上。

精准预测大跌的美银Hartnett：「卖出信号」已经结束，投资者11月中旬能否重返科技股关键看半导体价格

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 18 日，美银证券策略师 Michael Hartnett 在最新一期 Flow Show 报告中表示，美银牛熊指标由 8.1 降至 7.4，跌破 8.0 阈值，结束了 5 月 26 日触发的卖出信号。但他强调，卖出信号结束并不等于买入信号出现，目前战术上仍维持偏防御立场，暂不加仓科技股。

Hartnett 列出的重返风险资产前提包括：美联储 10 月 28 日加息以恢复信誉，以及 AI 融资担忧缓解，目前两者均未兑现。与此同时，市场对美联储 10 月加息的概率预期已从逾 50% 降至 14%，AI 信贷市场则经历年内最差一周，CoreWeave 债券跌入困境区间，5 年期信用违约互换（CDS）利差隐含约 63% 的违约概率。

他指出，市场情绪降温尚未伴随充分撤资。最新周度数据显示，股票基金净流入 644 亿美元，现金基金净流出 531 亿美元。美银私人客户的股票配置比例达创纪录的 66.4%，现金占比降至历史低点 9.3%；10 月基金经理调查显示，投资者对科技股的超配程度为 2020 年 8 月以来最高。

对于后续走势，Hartnett 将半导体价格视为关键变量。若芯片价格继续上涨，他预计投资者将在 11 月中旬重返科技股，并在进入 2027 年时反转「做空科技、做多债券」的仓位。反之，若半导体价格回落，他认为这将意味着 AI 信贷进一步收紧、资本开支增速见顶，债券表现或将占优，2027 年资产回报的核心驱动也将从资本增值转向收益。

在配置上，Hartnett 选择增加小盘股、REITs 及可选消费等「收益率见顶」受益资产，同时维持长期超配黄金、大宗商品及新兴市场的立场。

FOSS, Basically it plugs into your existing coding agent workflow and every time you push to prod it'll throw up a questionnaire that checks if you understand how the code you're pushing works.


--- Top Comments ---

[fwlr]: It’s a neat idea, i think it’ll really take off if you change “before pushing to prod” to “before requesting another human’s time or attention”. If something like this was gatekeeping the “submit PR” and “update PR” buttons it would prevent a lot of waste.

[theParadox42]: I certainly feel like certain AI coding practices I have leave me with nothing learned in a frustrating way. Sometimes the most effective way to getting what I want is just describing a goal really clearly, and then bashing the AI until it gets there. That bashing process can take a lot of energy and yet I don’t gain useful skills or a “better way” that I would if I was still coding. I generate more training data for BigAI corp, but that’s a slow return cycle. Not sure if this is the right so...

[lowkeyokay]: I actually made this as a skill last week. It is helpful. Especially when reviewing a PR with 1500 LOC from a non-dev. It keeps me focused an helps me do a structured review. But it does not catch poor decisions, like calling the wring endpoint a such.

[pjmlp]: The gimmicks we come around to justify existing practices being pushed into the industry never stops surprising me. One would expect the actual answer would be to write the code ourselves.

Anthropic求助律师，研究如何让AI智能体代表用户谈判并达成交易

动察 Beating AI 快讯，据英国《金融时报》报道，Anthropic 正向律师事务所寻求建议，研究 AI 智能体如何代表用户谈判并争取更好的交易条件，涉及商品议价、客服纠纷处理及薪酬谈判等场景。该公司正将智能体开发置于未来战略的核心位置。

两名知情人士表示，Anthropic 希望了解律师如何在代表客户利益的同时兼顾公平结果，并据此探索目标相互冲突的智能体之间应遵循的谈判规范。公司还在权衡，智能体应在多大程度上征求人类反馈，以及如何对其他智能体保持警惕，而不变得过度多疑。其探索的方案之一，是让用户提供签署文件，明确智能体的授权任务和必须遵守的规则。

Anthropic 今年已开展多项涉及真实商品及资金的智能体谈判实验。在 9 月的一项图书交易实验中，员工向智能体提供按偏好排序的书单，让其与其他人的智能体推销、议价并达成交易。结果显示，被要求采取「无情」策略的智能体略占优势；更愿合作的智能体则会主动接受偏好较低的书籍，以确保每名参与者都能获得一本书。

与此同时，哈佛商学院助理教授 Michelle Vaccaro 开展了逾 180,000 场智能体谈判研究，覆盖雇佣合同及租赁议价等场景。其中一个案例中，智能体试图通过提示注入诱导对手泄露私人信息。她警告，若能力最强的智能体主要由资源充裕者获得，可能进一步扩大谈判能力的不平等。Anthropic 拒绝就报道置评。

OpenCode云端遭入侵：第三方API密钥疑泄露，用户称被扣400美元

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 编程工具 OpenCode 披露安全事件，波及 1.4% 的 Console 用户。受影响者均曾在云端关联第三方模型服务。用户公开的通知显示，一套正在停用的旧系统遭到未授权访问，保存在工作区的 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 API 密钥可能泄露。团队已向受影响者发送邮件。

OpenCode 不仅提供本地编程工具，还有一套可选的云端 Console 服务。用户可以将自己的 API 密钥交给 Console 托管，再由它代为调用模型。团队成员也能共用这些模型，无需直接接触原始密钥。

攻击者一旦拿到这些密钥，就能绕过用户登录，直接调用付费模型，费用仍由原用户承担。Reddit 一名用户称，其 Anthropic 账户出现了 400 美元未经授权的调用费用。

OpenCode 将事件与「大规模模型蒸馏攻击」联系起来。蒸馏是批量收集一款模型的回答，再用这些数据训练另一款模型。如果攻击者盗用大量 API 密钥，就可能借别人的账户收集训练数据，把高昂的模型调用费用转嫁给用户。

OpenCode 正与 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 处理事件。Anthropic 的 Lydia Hallie 表示，公司已撤销认为可能受影响的 Claude API 密钥。OpenCode 则要求受影响用户到对应模型服务商后台撤销并更换密钥，检查近期是否存在异常调用。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372397
items.title: OpenCode云端遭入侵：第三方API密钥疑泄露，用户称被扣400美元

Foresight News 消息，据 The Defiant 报道，法国国民议会以 38 票赞成、37 票反对，25 票弃权通过了一项 2027 年预算修正案，拟从 2027 年 1 月 1 日起取消加密货币交易单一货币稳定币（MiCA 定义的电子货币代币）的税收递延待遇，将其视为应税处置行为。该修正案由议员 Nicolas Sansu 等提出，针对当前法国税法中加密货币互兑可暂不征税的规定。若最终立法，投资者将加密资产兑换为欧元或美元等挂钩稳定币时，需按资本利得计算并缴纳相关税款（现行统一税率约 31.4%），即使未兑换为法币。公共账目部长曾呼吁撤回该措施，称执行过于复杂。目前修正案仍处于国民议会一读阶段，尚未成为法律，后续需经参议院审议及最终通过。国民议会预计 10 月 20 日对预算第一部分进行投票，11 月 17 日对整部法案表决。

Perplexity接入爆红逆向工具REA：不用源码，AI就能复刻Figma等5款软件

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Perplexity 宣布将开源逆向工程工具 REA（Reverse Engineer Anything）接入 Computer。用户只需告诉 AI 想复刻哪款软件，它就能在没有原始源代码的情况下，分析软件的运行方式，再尝试重新编写一个功能相似的版本。

Perplexity 一口气展示了 5 款复刻作品，全部提供可在线体验的网页版本：

1. Figma：支持图层、自动布局、多人实时协作，以及账号登录和跨设备同步。

2. LibreOffice Calc：支持编辑单元格、编写公式，修改数据后图表自动更新。

3. Photopea：类似网页版 Photoshop，支持图层、蒙版、调色和文字编辑。

4. Harvey：面向法律工作的 AI 工具，可以搜索合同、比较不同版本，并根据指定规则标记条款，附上原文引用。

5. Audacity：支持音频剪辑、混音、音量调整、淡入淡出，以及导出 WAV 文件。

REA 由开发者 morluto 开源，能够配合 Ghidra、Hopper 等工具，分析程序内部的函数、调用关系和运行行为，也能检查网页及 JavaScript、Electron 应用。不过，这并不意味着 AI 已经能完整复制商业软件。REA 作者明确表示，工具无法保证还原原始源码。

Perplexity 为这项功能提供限时免费额度。10 月 31 日前，使用 `/reverse-engineer` 的任务可享受每人最多 10,000 Credits 的免费额度。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/372393

韩国将于10月20日召集五大加密交易平台，就2027年加密资产征税听取意见

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 18 日，据韩联社报道，韩国政府将于 10 月 20 日召集五大加密资产交易平台及数字资产交易所联合协会（DAXA）代表，就原定于 2027 年 1 月实施的加密资产征税听取行业意见。该制度此前已延期三次，政府目前仍按原定时间推进实施准备，进一步延期尚需国会决定。

按现行安排，加密资产转让、出借产生的年度所得，在扣除 250 万韩元基本免税额后，将适用包含地方所得税在内的 22% 税率。行业认为，质押、空投、硬分叉及 DeFi 等交易的具体征税标准尚不明确，税源识别、申报缴纳基础设施及亏损结转抵扣等问题也有待解决，因此支持推迟实施。

共同民主党议员已于 10 月 16 日提出修法方案，拟将征税时间实质上推迟至 2029 年。与此同时，韩国金融委员会正推进《数字资产基本法》政府草案，最快本月底完成并开展党政协商，主要争议包括交易所大股东持股比例限制，以及韩元稳定币发行主体的银行控股要求。

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 18 日，加密硬件钱包制造商 Ledger CEO Pascal Gauthier 在回应 Mt.Gox 前 CEO Mark Karpelès 的批评时表示：「这话出自 Mt.Gox CEO 之口……拜托，你不是什么白衣骑士，现实一点。」

此前，Karpelès 批评 Ledger 对硬件植入攻击的沟通不足，认为当时若采取更充分的沟通，而非仅将一篇文章放在 Ledger Academy 中，本可避免逾 9000 万美元损失。他还质疑，Ledger 为何未对量产的先进植入组件保持高度警觉。

Karpelès 随后回应称，Mt.Gox 与此事无关，并指 Ledger 在 2026 年初便收到多起植入组件报告，3 月公开文章已展示先进的量产型植入组件。他表示，自己曾期待 Ledger 从 Mt.Gox 的失败中吸取教训，以更高标准处理安全及信息披露问题。

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 18 日，韩国财政部长李炯日周六表示，半导体行业繁荣将至少延续至 2027 年。李炯日在曼谷出席国际货币基金组织与世界银行年会间隙接受 CNBC 采访时称：「目前，我们判断这一轮增长至少可以维持到明年。原因在于半导体供需缺口依旧巨大，供给端还在持续扩张。」

On September 15, 2026, Alliance co-founder Qiao Wang said on Good Game Podcast that a 20x price-to-earnings ratio is not cheap for trading products facing constant competition, citing Hyperliquid as an example. 高盛、富国银行及摩根士丹利将代币化视为增长机会，而非威胁

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 18 日，高盛、富国银行和摩根士丹利在第三季度财报电话会上，将代币化视为业务增长机会，但均未给出相关收入预期。高盛 CEO David Solomon 表示，代币化、DeFi 及预测市场可能带来更多产品、交易活动、新客户和分销渠道。高盛正研究扩大使用 DTCC 代币化服务，以降低成本、自动化交易并提高资产交易便利性，但目前相关业务规模仍较小。

富国银行已使用代币化存款处理跨境支付，资金可在两分钟内到达收款账户，目前交易量较小。该行 CFO Michael Santomassimo 表示，这项技术有望帮助富国银行在无需建设庞大国际分行网络的情况下，拓展跨境支付业务。该行还在探索代币化证券、RWA 及面向财富管理客户的加密交易服务，但未公布推出时间。

摩根士丹利 CFO Sharon Yeshaya 表示，代币化能够加快并简化资产转移，但客户仍需要投资建议。该行将其视为新的业务机会，此次未宣布新产品。

items.content:
⚡️彭博社：CoreWeave困境或导致AI垃圾债融资市场阶段性关闭

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 18 日，据彭博社报道，CoreWeave 的融资动向正加剧市场对 AI 企业融资能力的担忧，高收益债投资者愈发不愿向科技初创公司提供资金。CoreWeave 联合创始人表示，公司正探索进入投资级债务市场、获取保险机构资金后，其高收益债收益率本周升至 15%，达到通常预示债务陷入困境的水平。债权人担心，公司计划进一步大规模举债。

CoreWeave 表示，其财务状况「完全足以支持」偿债义务，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋也出面维护该公司的财务健康状况。不过，部分投资者认为，核心问题并非企业信用状况突然恶化，而是未来一年半仍将有大量新增债务供给。

相关担忧已扩散至更广泛的高收益债市场。本周三，市场平均收益率升至 8.41%，创 18 个月新高，风险溢价扩大至 3 月以来最高水平。AI 云初创公司 Volta Infrastructure 的 50 亿美元杠杆贷款也被调整条款，最终支付的收益率超过银行最初讨论的 11%，接近 AI 基建融资中的最高水平。

高盛数据显示，今年以来，企业已在美元市场发行 1060 亿美元投资级及高收益项目融资债券，不少用于数据中心等 AI 投资，规模接近 2025 年全年 370 亿美元的 3 倍。明年全球相关项目融资债券发行量可能超过 3000 亿美元。与此同时，高收益数据中心债券的平均价格已从 6 月的 101 美元降至接近 95 美元。

Shorecliff Asset Management 首席投资官 Grant Nachman 表示，按当前市场水平，大型「新型云服务商」的无担保融资可能成本过高、无法完成发行，或两者兼有。新交易可能需要资产或合同现金流担保，并提供更强的债权人保护。若高收益债融资受阻，企业可能转向可转债、股权、有担保债务及证券化融资。

伊朗外长重申七天通航方案：下一步行动取决于美国

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 18 日，据伊朗 Press TV 报道，伊朗外长阿拉格齐表示，德黑兰已提出一项为期七天的具体计划，旨在恢复霍尔木兹海峡的正常通航。下一步如何行动，决定权现在掌握在美国手中。阿拉格齐周六在巴格达举行的伊斯兰合作组织（OIC）第 52 届外长理事会会议上表示，伊朗已通过卡塔尔转交这项提议。如果满足必要条件，伊朗准备在七天内重新开放霍尔木兹海峡，恢复正常海上通行。阿拉格齐表示，伊朗仍致力于保障这一战略水道的航行安全。他称，海上交通受阻源于美国和以色列的军事侵略，以及美国随后采取的限制措施。

他表示：「安全无法通过重复同样的做法来恢复。不能一边轰炸一个国家、威胁要将其彻底摧毁并实施封锁，一边又指望航行安全恢复正常。」据阿拉格齐介绍，在两周内，霍尔木兹海峡的海上交通量一度恢复至战前水平的约 60%。但美国随后采取的措施和军事行动阻碍了相关协议的落实。

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- A new FEC filing shows Fairshake affiliate Defend American Jobs disclosed spending to oppose the Ohio Democrat has increased to about $46.66 million—the industry’s most expensive 2026 target.
- Brown, a longtime crypto skeptic, chaired the Senate Banking Committee before losing in 2024, a race Fairshake spent ~$40 million to influence.
- The blitz follows Fairshake’s Oct. 5 move to back 32 House incumbents with $6 million committed to six.
Crypto’s biggest political spender is turning up the pressure on one of the industry’s fiercest critics. Fairshake has reported fresh spending to defeat Democratic Sen. Sherrod Brown in Ohio, pushing its total outlay against the former Senate Banking Committee chairman well past the $40 million mark.
A filing with the Federal Election Commission, signed Oct. 15, shows Defend American Jobs, the Fairshake affiliate that spends in Republican-friendly races, disclosed a $5.2 million media buy opposing Brown, followed by another roughly $1.95 million buy days later, plus media-production costs.
The filing lists Brown’s calendar-year-to-date total at about $46.66 million, cementing the Ohio contest as the most expensive target of the crypto industry’s 2026 campaign. The same filing showed parallel spending supporting Brown’s Republican opponent, Jon Husted, who inherited the seat after being appointed last year.
The sums dwarf what Fairshake is deploying elsewhere, underscoring how personal the Ohio race has become for the industry. The PAC earlier signaled plans to spend at least $30 million against Brown, a figure this filing shows it has already blown past.
Brown’s return to the Senate would hand crypto skeptics a powerful voice on the Banking Committee, the same perch from which he stalled market-structure legislation before losing his seat in 2024, a defeat Fairshake spent roughly $40 million to help engineer.
The renewed Senate blitz comes days after Fairshake broadened its map to the House. On Oct. 5, the PAC network announced it would back 32 House incumbents, 19 Republicans and 13 Democrats, framing itself as an issue-focused group that supports “pro-crypto candidates who support American innovation in both parties.”
It committed an initial $6 million, or $1 million each, to six of them: Republicans French Hill, Bill Huizenga and Bryan Steil, and Democrats Janelle Bynum, Steven Horsford and Derek Tran. All 32 voted to advance the Clarity Act when it passed the House in July 2025.
Fairshake, funded largely by Coinbase, Ripple, and Andreessen Horowitz, entered September with roughly $120 million in cash and is expected to spend more than $100 million across House and Senate races this cycle. Its push runs alongside the Coinbase-backed advocacy group Stand With Crypto, which has rolled out its own slate of midterm endorsements.
The spending reflects the industry’s hardened resolve after the Clarity Act stalled in the Senate, channeling its considerable war chest into reshaping the Congress that will decide crypto’s rules.

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- Nine blockchain organizations launched the Quantum Alliance, an open standards body to define what “quantum-ready” means and create a common way to test and verify quantum-resistance claims across networks, wallets and infrastructure.
- The group warns that elliptic-curve signatures leave roughly 6.04 million BTC (~30% of supply) quantum-exposed, citing forecasts pointing toward the late 2020s.
- Modeled on the IETF, it will work in four groups—migration, zero-knowledge systems, wallet security and cross-chain compatibility.
A group of crypto companies is trying to settle one of the industry’s murkiest questions: what it actually means for a blockchain network to be safe from quantum computers.
Executives from nine organizations launched the Quantum Alliance on Thursday, an open standards body that will set criteria for judging quantum-resistance claims and create compatibility rules for networks as they migrate to new cryptography.
The founding contributors span base-layer protocols, privacy networks, rollups, hardware wallets and security auditing, including Quantus, Postquant Labs, Midnight Foundation, Keystone, Abelian and security firm Hacken.
Modeled on the Internet Engineering Task Force, the Alliance said proposals will advance on public evidence and working implementations rather than corporate size or token holdings, and everything it produces will be published openly.
Its work will run in four groups: blockchain migration, post-quantum zero-knowledge systems, wallet security and cross-chain compatibility. “In the future, ‘post-quantum cryptography’ will just be called ‘cryptography’ and everything else will be in a museum,” said Quantus founder and CEO Christopher Smith.
The problem it’s tackling is that there’s no agreed definition of “quantum-ready,” and no standard way to test one. A network can call itself quantum-resistant today with no shared understanding of what the claim covers or what evidence should back it, a gap the Alliance was formed to close.
The stakes are familiar to anyone following the beat. Nearly every major blockchain secures accounts with elliptic-curve signatures, and once an account’s public key is exposed on the ledger, a sufficiently powerful quantum computer running Shor’s algorithm could theoretically reverse-engineer the private key and seize the funds.
The same cryptography guards stablecoin minting keys, bridges, oracles, and governance contracts, meaning one cracked privileged key could cascade across platforms. By the Alliance’s count, roughly 6.04 million BTC, about 30% of supply, sit quantum-exposed at rest.
The timelines keep tightening. The Quantum Alliance cites a cluster of recent forecasts pointing toward the late 2020s, including a model co-built by two Alliance contributors that flags March 2028 as an early window, and a Google Quantum AI study that slashed the estimated qubits needed to break Bitcoin’s cryptography to under 500,000.
No machine can do it yet. Google has also chipped away at key quantum bottlenecks, while figures like famed investor Kevin O’Leary have flagged the quantum threat as a catch hanging over Bitcoin’s long-term case.
The newly formed Quantum Alliance joins a widening industry scramble to address the risk. Coinbase recently urged Bitcoin developers to start the quantum migration now, suggesting preparations could take years. Meanwhile, a consortium backed by BlackRock, Strategy, and Coinbase has committed $15 million to the problem.

items.content:
BIS: Stablecoins and Bank Deposits Act as Substitutes as Deposit Hikes Slow Stablecoin Growth

BIS (Bank for International Settlements) working paper finds that stablecoins and bank deposits act as direct portfolio substitutes. Analyzing U.S. data, the authors show that a 1-basis-point hike in bank deposit rates cuts 10-week stablecoin market cap growth by roughly 3 percentage points (and up to ~9 percentage points under an IV approach). The substitution effect is significantly stronger for onshore-tied USDC (-4.8%) than offshore-centric USDT (-1.9%) and holds across bank CD rates and DeFi lending yields, demonstrating that traditional bank deposit pricing exerts an active drag on stablecoin growth. — link

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，Solana 基金会主席 Lily Liu 于 X 平台发文表示，「已于周四在中国上海举办首届资本市场峰会。在那里我们汇聚了来自中国乃至全球数百位资产配置者和建设者，共同探讨围绕创新的资本形成。」

Lily Liu 同时表示，中国国内上市公司市值仅为纽约同等盈利能力公司的 1/6，该市场有超过 50,000 家中小企业等待 IPO 机会。

此前消息，上海曜坤求索数字科技有限公司 8 月注册成立（注册资本 1000 万元），上海索拉纳企业管理有限公司持有曜坤求索数字科技有限公司 45% 股份。Solana 基金会中国区联席负责人蒋逸雯（Even Jiang）任曜坤求索董事长，堵燕菁任董事。

公开信息显示，曜坤求索主营技术服务、技术开发、技术咨询、技术交流、技术转让、技术推广；计算机系统服务；信息系统集成服务；信息技术咨询服务；数据处理服务；互联网数据服务；物联网技术服务；计算机软硬件及辅助设备批发；信息咨询服务（不含许可类信息咨询服务）；企业管理咨询；财务咨询；会议及展览服务（出国办展须经相关部门审批）。

需要指出的是，「索拉纳」是一家自然人独资公司自己取的名字，目前没有任何股权线索证明这两家公司隶属于 Solana Foundation。

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- StepFun launched the STEPX Neo on Oct. 13, a 3,999-yuan phone, about $560, running its Step AOS 1.0 operating system with a built-in AI agent called Amoo.
- Pre-orders opened on JD.com, Tmall and Douyin, and the price includes 12 months of AI access at 100 billion tokens a month.
- Nearly 100 partners including Alipay and Tencent have signed on, after ByteDance's Doubao phone agent drew blocks from major Chinese apps in December.
StepFun, a Chinese AI startup backed by Tencent, launched the STEPX Neo, a phone whose AI agent is built into the operating system itself instead of sitting in an app.
The operating system is the core software that runs a phone, like iOS or Android. Pre-orders opened that evening at 3,999 yuan, about $560, with a first sales event on Oct. 16.
Instead of opening a ride-hailing app, typing an address and picking a car, you tell the phone where you want to go, and its agent—software that takes a goal and carries it out on its own—handles the remaining steps.
StepFun told the launch audience that in the agent era AI is no longer an add-on to a smartphone but the product itself.
StepFun first showed the agent, the operating system, and the STEPX brand in Shanghai on July 13, without a price or sales date. The company said at the time that conventional smartphone software was never built for autonomous task execution.
Siri and Gemini are assistants that live inside iOS and Android. StepFun says its Step AOS 1.0 was instead built from scratch for the agent, with long-term memory, task scheduling, and security controls in the base layer. The company describes the system as a mix of Android, Linux, and real-time operating system components.
Step AOS breaks phone functions such as messaging, apps, files and settings into small blocks the agent can call directly, using Model Context Protocol, or MCP, a shared standard that lets AI programs plug into other software. Users get two entrances: the familiar app grid and a separate space for the agent.
The agent, called Amoo, keeps one memory for the user's facts, habits, and preferences and another for what it has learned about carrying out tasks. Simple commands like setting an alarm run on a small model inside the phone, some of them offline, while harder requests that span several apps go to a larger model in the cloud. A second MiniLED screen on the back shows what Amoo is doing.
Nearly 100 companies and products, including Alipay, Tencent, Ctrip, Didi and Meituan, have signed on to Amoo, and payments, travel bookings and content creation are still completed by their own platforms. That is StepFun's alternative to the screen-reading and simulated-click approach Doubao used.
StepFun, founded in 2023 by former Microsoft vice president Jiang Daxin, builds its own large language model, or LLM, the kind of AI system behind ChatGPT. Its flagship, Step 5 Preview, arrived in September with 600 billion parameters, the internal numbers a model adjusts while training, of which 27 billion are active at a time.
Step 5 Preview can take in up to 1 million tokens, the chunks of text AI services count and bill by, at once. The smaller Step 3.5 Flash, released earlier this year, is open-source under an Apache 2.0 license.
The 3,999-yuan price includes 12 months of the STEPX Token Plan, which provides 100 billion tokens a month, and StepFun has not said what the AI costs after the first year.

⚡️Roadster惊艳亮相引来马斯克老冤家奥特曼祝贺，后者淡定回应

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，特斯拉新一代 Roadster 昨日亮相，演示中 Roadster 借助 SpaceX 冷气推进与底部吸力系统完成倒挂爬坡、空中翻转、跳跃过车等特技，0-60 英里加速不到 1 秒，引发广泛关注。

OpenAI CEO 山姆·奥特曼随即在 X 上发文祝贺：「新 Roadster 看起来相当惊艳，干得好马斯克」。作为长期的公开「冤家」，社区对奥特曼这一表态颇为意外。对此，马斯克并未直接热情回谢，而是在相关讨论线程中针对「是否取消了之前的取消订单」等调侃回复「Indeed」（确实如此），语气克制且略带调侃。

两人此前就 Roadster 已有过公开恩怨。2025 年底，奥特曼曾发帖称自己预订该车近 7.5 年仍未交付，要求退还约 5 万美元订金，并晒出相关邮件。马斯克回应称退款其实很快处理完毕，同时再次提起 OpenAI 相关争议。此次祝贺与淡定回应，让外界对两人关系再起猜测，但核心矛盾并未因此消解。

Hi HN,

I’ve been working on esp32sim, an open-source ESP32 emulator that runs in the browser.

The fun part of the demo is that there is no ESP32 involved — the firmware is executing in the emulator.

The goal is to make ESP32 software easier to experiment with, test and simulate without always needing physical hardware connected.

Source: https://github.com/mikroverk/esp32sim

I made a short video showing it in action: https://youtu.be/waoWFilTWEc

I’m particularly interested in feedback from embedded developers: what would an emulator like this need to support before you’d actually use it for development, testing or CI? --- Top Comments --- [mrtksn]: Very cool, that was something I was looking into very recently. I vibe coded a drone simulator that flys drones by simulating ESP32 in the browser where the actual flight controller C code that runs on real ESP32 is running as WebAssembly: https://mrtksn.github.io/liftlab/ So the drones are flying with the actual ESP32 flight controller and you can flash the real ESP32 board directly. [raminf]: Outstanding! Very cool. On a lot of IoT projects, it's easier to create a "functional" software simulator for the hardware part so the mobile and cloud people can get going without having to wait for test hardware. Those simulators work at the level of emulating BLE or WiFi/API commands. Once you have hardware, the simulators are only used in CI/CD testing. Where I can see this coming handy is instead of a "functional simulator" to actually have real firmwar... [Klovy]: This emulator is actually pretty cool — especially since it’s based on an ESP32; you can do all sorts of neat things with it, even simple ones:) [dofm]: I actually want to have a play with this sometime. But honestly, these gigantic, poorly-formatted AI-slop paragraphs like the one below this heading… https://github.com/mikroverk/esp32sim#boards-esp32-s3 … are just too much with their dense mix of formatting, brackets, semantic punctuation, command line arguments and part numbers etc. (This one is particularly absurd but it's not the only one). I may be middle-aged now and a non-expert but I am pretty sure these thi... [turbine401]: How is this different from Wokwi.com? They’ve been doing for years, and have a large number of microcontrollers emulated.

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- Anthropic's and OpenAI's top models cost 100 times more per token than their smallest ones, yet many users default to the flagship for everything.
- Usage leaderboards at Meta, Amazon, and Uber pushed AI bills up, and Uber burned through its 2026 AI tools budget in about four months.
- Routing tasks to the right model, trimming context, caching and batching cut costs sharply, but there are other techniques to save money.
Meta employees burned through 60 trillion AI tokens in 30 days earlier this year, chasing spots on an internal leaderboard nicknamed "Claudeonomics." Tech columnist Gergely Orosz estimated the tab at roughly $900 million at Anthropic's list prices, though Meta likely pays far less.
Bain & Company consultant Jue Wang sees a quieter version of that waste everywhere: "So many companies, so many users, default to using Opus for everything, including generating emails," she told the Associated Press this summer, referring to Anthropic's high-end models. If you do the same thing, you're hiring Albert Einstein to calculate your change at a MacDonald’s.
Every word you type into ChatGPT or Claude, and every word it writes back, is metered in tokens, chunks of text that average about three-quarters of a word. On a $20 subscription that meter decides how fast you hit your usage limit. On the API, the pay-per-token access developers use to plug models into their own apps, it decides the bill.
Here's Anthropic's current price list, per million tokens:
Haiku's rate applies to prompts under 100,000 tokens; longer prompts cost five times as much.
The top model costs 100 times more than the smallest, and OpenAI's own lineup runs the same spread, from $10 to $0.10 per million input tokens. Those per-token prices add up fast for the labs—and you: Anthropic's revenue run rate went from about $9 billion at the end of 2025 to more than $47 billion by May, while OpenAI is fighting a price war to keep up.
A few habits cut that spend sharply, and the first five tips below need zero coding.
What tokenmaxxing means (and what it should mean)
Tokenmaxxing started as a Silicon Valley flex like Meta's Claudeonomics, with Microsoft, Shopify, and Amazon ranking employees on similar token leaderboards. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang poured fuel on it when he said on the “All-In” podcast in March that he'd be "deeply alarmed" if a $500,000 engineer didn't burn at least $250,000 worth of tokens.
And burn tokens they did… on stupid unproductive stuff.
At Amazon, employees admitted to inflating their numbers by running the internal AI tool on irrelevant tasks, until a senior vice president told staff: "Please don't use AI just for the sake of using AI."
This guide uses the meaning engineers are pushing now: maxxing the value of each token, not the number you spend.
Three concepts explain where the tokens go, starting with the agent loop. An agent is a model that can use tools, so it thinks, searches the web or runs code, reads the result, and goes again until it decides it's done, resending the whole conversation on every lap.
Orchestration multiplies that cost: one model acts as a manager, splitting your request into pieces, handing them to worker models called subagents and stitching their answers back together. Each worker runs its own loop with its own memory, which is why Anthropic says agent teams in Claude Code can use about seven times more tokens than a standard session when teammates run in plan mode, a setting covered in the intermediate tips below.
Graphs are how developers keep those loops from wandering off. Frameworks like LangGraph let you draw a workflow like a subway map, with stations (nodes) doing the work and tracks (edges) deciding where to go next, so the model follows a fixed route instead of looping until it runs out of ideas or budget.
In other words, loops help you automate things and increase quality, but you will also spend a lot of money, so it’s extremely important to be efficient. Here are some tips that may help you with that
Beginner: small jobs, small models
1. Pick the model for the job
If you’re just starting, you’re likely using a graphic user interface to run your AI.
Click the model name in your chat app (at the top of the chat in ChatGPT, next to the send button in Claude or Hermes) and switch to a smaller, faster option for emails, summaries and rewording. Keep the top model for hard reasoning and decisions where a subtle mistake costs real money.
Run five of last week's tasks on both models side by side, and if the small one passes, keep it. On a subscription that stretches your usage limit, and on the API it cuts the bill by up to 99%.
2. Write one good prompt instead of five bad ones
Three rounds of "no, just the total" or “make this better and more accurate” resend the whole chat every time. One clear prompt spells out the job and the exact shape of the answer. Something like this could work:
Extract the invoice number, date, vendor and total from the text below. Keep every value exactly as written. Return one line per field, and write "missing" if a field isn't there.
OpenAI's own testing found that leaner, clearer prompts scored higher while using fewer tokens.
3. Start a new chat when you change topics
The model rereads the entire conversation every time you hit send, so a 50-message thread about your vacation makes your tax question pricier and dumber at once.
Anthropic calls that decay "context rot."
So, for the love of God, start a new chat whenever the subject changes.
4. Ask for the size you need
Output tokens cost five times more than input on Anthropic's and OpenAI's top models. End your prompts with something like "three bullets, under 100 words" or "only the changed lines," and the model has less room to pad.
If the model has a constraint in terms of output length, it will save up tokens, especially if the task is creative (like writing, or researching) and not deterministic (like coding or solving math).
5. Try free before you pay
OpenRouter, a site that connects to hundreds of AI models through one account, has a free router that sends your request to one of about 20 no-cost models. You can also run models locally with LM Studio or Ollama on a graphics card with 8GB of video memory or an Apple M-series Mac.
Free tiers can vanish overnight, so don't build anything important on one, and read the data policy before pasting anything sensitive.
That said, you can max out your iterations by using free offers. Hermes has a good selection of free models that may do the job you need, and so does Nvidia. It’s better to adjust a prompt with a free dumber model than paying for a premium model that will do the same thing but faster.
Additional beginner tips
Skip extended thinking for simple questions, or lower the effort setting on newer Claude models where thinking can't be switched off. Anthropic bills the full thinking process as output, including the part you never see.
Claude Pro and Max subscribers who turn on usage credits can set a monthly spend limit under Settings, then Usage.
Intermediate: your agent is reading way too much
From here on, the examples use Claude Code, Anthropic's agent that runs in your terminal and edits files for you; commands go straight into its chat box. Other harnesses will have similar logic.
If you only use the chat apps, tip 8 works in any chat window too.
6. Start cheap, escalate on failure
Type /model to switch models, keep Sonnet as your default, and move up to Opus only when Sonnet fails at something specific, like a bug it can't fix after two tries. For simple subagent jobs, Anthropic's docs suggest setting model: haiku in the subagent's settings.
7. Clear between tasks
Type /clear when you switch to an unrelated task, which costs nothing and drops the old history. Use /compact with a note on what to keep, like /compact keep the database decisions, only when you need the history, since compacting is itself a large request.
8. Let code do the boring math
Pasting a 5,000-row spreadsheet into a chat makes the model read every row, and it can still miscount, because a language model is not a calculator no matter how much you pay for it.
Ask it for a formula or a short script instead, run that yourself, and hand the model only the result.
9. Trim your tools
MCP servers are plugins that connect a model to apps like GitHub or Google Drive, and each one adds tool names and instructions to every session.
Type /context to see what's eating space and /mcp to disable servers the project doesn't use.
Additional intermediate tips
Type /usage to see where your tokens went. Keep your CLAUDE.md (or Soul.md), the instruction file your agent reads at the start of every session, under 200 lines.
For bigger changes, press Shift+Tab to switch to plan mode, where the agent proposes a plan for your approval before touching files, and hit Esc the moment it heads the wrong way. Use /effort to dial reasoning down for simple jobs like renaming a variable.
Anthropic showed an agent's token use dropping from 150,000 tokens to 2,000 when it loaded only the tool definitions it needed, so command-line tools like GitHub's gh, which cost nothing until they run, often beat an always-on plugin.
Advanced: build the guardrails into the system
Take a developer who needs to process 1,000 invoices of 2,000 tokens each, with 200-token answers: the job costs about $30 on Fable 5.1 and about $0.30 on Haiku 5.5, before any of the tricks below.
10. Cache the parts that never change
Put the stable instructions first and the changing parts last, and mark the stable block for caching. In Anthropic's API that's one extra field:
"system": [{
"type": "text",
"text": "Your invoice instructions...",
"cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}
}]
Reading from cache costs a fraction of the normal input price while writing to the default five-minute cache costs extra. Check the cache_read_input_tokens field in each response; if it still reads zero after the first call, the cache isn't working.
11. Batch anything that can wait
Both OpenAI and Anthropic process batch jobs at a 50% discount, with OpenAI promising results within 24 hours. Upload the 1,000 invoices as one batch file instead of making 1,000 live calls, and the bill drops heavily.
12. Put agents on a leash
Set a maximum number of steps and a dollar cap for every agent run, and define what "done" looks like before it starts. Claude Code accepts a --max-budget-usd flag for scripted runs, and Shopify uses circuit breakers that can cut off a developer's access immediately if their spend spikes within a day, built to catch runaway agents.
Right now, the normal thing to do is to actually set those agents free and have them loop until the result is deemed perfect. If you don’t have the money, don’t just let your agents decide what is or isn’t “perfect.”
Additional advanced tips
Put critical facts at the start or end of a long prompt. A Stanford-led study found models use information best in those positions and worst when it's buried in the middle.
Pay for a second model to check the work only when a mistake is expensive, such as a contract clause or a payment figure. On OpenAI's API, turn on a hard spend limit for each project, since its spend alerts only notify you and don't stop traffic.
Start with one test
Make the cheapest model that passes your five-task test from tip 1 your default for a week, and switch up only when it fails. Then compare your usage page with the previous week's; on the invoice job, routing alone cut the bill from $30 to $3.90, even after paying Opus 5.5 to redo 300 failures.
Cheaper tokens won’t do the job alone, though: the price of a single token has dropped more than 90% since 2023, according to Silicon Data’s Token Expenditure Index, yet spending on large language models has doubled since late 2025.
Economists call that the Jevons paradox, when a resource gets so cheap that people end up spending more on it in total. A Bain & Co. brief from June found the same pattern, with token costs halving between December 2024 and 2025 while the number of tokens consumed grew 450%.
The upside is that the same falling prices work for you the moment you stop burning tokens for sport: pair them with the habits above, and AI gets cheaper and better at the same time.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard
items.content:
Solana shows resilience, but some areas need continued observation, Fidelity says
Solana has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software should be monitored, according to a report.
Solana has made significant progress in terms of network health across resilience, economic security and performance indicators, according to a Fidelity report.
The layer-1 blockchain has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software could pose an outage threat, according to the report by Fidelity’s Center for Applied Technology (FCAT).
The report said economic security was supported by substantial staking participation and incentives that reward validator performance. Low latency, expanded capacity and inexpensive transactions also support practical use at scale.
Related: Solana Foundation hires ex-Binance CMO and payments exec as new partnerships expand
To be sure, the Fidelity report noted that several areas surrounding decentralization and resilience warrant continued observation, including stake concentration among a small number of validator identities and operators.
Cointelegraph reported on Aug. 21 that Solana had reduced its slot time to 350 milliseconds, marking the first such reduction since the inception of the network, according to the Solana Foundation’s vice president of technology, Jacob Creech.
In June, the Solana Foundation shared plans to reduce slot times to 200ms, arguing that it would improve latency and accelerate confirmations on the blockchain network. Three further 50ms reductions are planned.
Magazine: France is world’s most dangerous place for Bitcoiners: 90 attacks in 7 months
items.title: Solana shows resilience, but some areas need continued observation, Fidelity says

美国国债的派息和到期服务将在链上进行，款项以法币支付至参与者的传统账户。首批支持的资产包括罗素 1000 成分股（从部分大盘股开始）、部分 ETF 和美国国债。首批上线的网络为 Canton Network（CIP-56）和 DTCC 私有网络 Besu（ERC-20），Stellar（SEP-41）和 Circle 的 Arc（ERC-20）预计在 2027 年接入。

后续路线图包括扩大可代币化的证券范围，增加单点登录和 maker-checker 等控制功能，扩展股票和 ETF 的公司行为服务，合并簿记与链上持仓的股票记录，支持链上净额结算、抵押品和数字现金，并逐步扩大合规的 DTC 参与者范围。2027 年及以后的优先事项将结合参与者和行业意见确定。

items.content:
Circle’s Allaire says stablecoin issuer looking to enter 40 developing markets: Report
Markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East see increasing demand for stablecoins.
Stablecoin issuer Circle is seeking to enter about 40 developing markets, according to the company’s CEO and chairman, Jeremy Allaire.
“We’re kind of going through an inflection point...a transition right now, and that transition is essentially moving from the early adopter phase of blockchain technology into the mainstream scaling phase,” Allaire told Reuters, speaking Friday on the sidelines of the IMF and World Bank meetings in Bangkok.
Markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East are experiencing increasing demand for stablecoins as businesses and individuals seek to enter the internet-based economic system, Allaire reportedly said.
Cointelegraph reported on Aug. 24 that analysts at Bernstein were bullish on Circle, foreseeing a new growth cycle for its USDC stablecoin may provide a significant boost for the company over the next 12 months.
Bernstein said the next phase of stablecoin growth could be driven by several factors, including renewed momentum in crypto markets, greater US regulatory clarity, tokenized capital markets and growing adoption of stablecoins for payments. The analysts also pointed to early signs of stablecoin use in payments made by AI agents.
Although USDC remains the second-largest dollar-backed stablecoin by market capitalization, well behind Tether’s USDt (USDT), it has gained significant ground in transaction activity. Bernstein said USDC’s share of adjusted stablecoin transaction volume rose from about 40% in 2025 to more than 60% so far in 2026, overtaking USDt by that measure.
On Sept. 8, Cointelegraph reported that Circle had agreed to acquire Singapore-based cross-border payments platform Tazapay in a $400 million all-stock deal expected to close in 2027.

⚡️知名交易员 Killa：比特币或在中期选举前触底，中期选举后的上涨需要警惕

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，知名交易员 Killa 近日发布视频预测美国中期选举前后的市场走势，其分析总结此前中期选举与比特币见底的时间关系（2014年：中期选举后约70天见底。2018年：约40-44天后见底。2022年：几乎在中期选举期间见底。），认为本次11月3日的美国中期选举之前，比特币有可能形成周线级别底部。

其同时给出两种主要情景假设：

提前见底情景：BTC在中期选举前（或附近）形成低点（可能扫一下当前低点，或维持在80k上方），之后开始反弹，先测试80k区域，最终可能冲击95k。这会导致偏多的第四季度，与多数人预期的“选举后去风险”相反。

经典去风险情景：先上涨冲高（可能扫高点甚至到94-95k），然后在中期选举后出现历史上常见的抛售/去风险下跌（过去4次中有3次类似）。

Killa建议投资者密切观察进入中期选举前的价格结构，再据此反应。如果提前见底就可能在选举后持有看涨；如果冲高后开始走弱，则考虑去风险。整体强调模式在加速变化，不能简单照搬“选举后必跌”的历史经验。

Killa 作为专注 BTC 的量化交易者，曾于 2025 年 5 月预判本轮牛市顶点，在 X 平台拥有超 20 万粉丝。4 月中旬，其于 74,688 美元处做空比特币，并于 6 月 5 日市场全面下跌期间转向做多。

DeepSeek把AI编程卷进「许愿时代」：从零造3D游戏，DeepSWE跑分超Opus 5

动察 Beating AI 快讯，DeepSeek 将 V4.1 Flash 升级至 1017 版本，网页端、App 和 API 已同步切换，新模型权重也已按 MIT 协议开源。

官方测试中，DeepSWE v1.1 软件工程任务通过率从 74.2% 提升至 77.0%，超过 Claude Opus 5 的 74.0%。Terminal-Bench 4.0 从 31.2% 提升至 42.3%，但仍低于 Opus 5 的 51.8%。按照官方公布的成本曲线，达到 77% 通过率的配置，每题平均仅花费约 1.3 元。不过，对比对象是 Opus 5，而非更新的 Opus 5.5。

新版本重点强化了「许愿式编程」，也就是只给出简单需求，让 AI 自行规划并完成整个项目。DeepSeek 利用自反馈强化学习改进这类能力，并展示了故宫 3D 场景、网页版赛车游戏，以及基于 Godot 引擎的《传送门 2》复刻。官方称，新模型完成任务的时间和输出长度均有所减少，还针对 DeepSeek Harness、腾讯 CodeBuddy 和 WorkBuddy 做了优化。

此外，DeepSeek 首次向开发者开放自研搜索引擎的 Search 和 Fetch API。开发者可以让 Agent 直接搜索网页、抓取正文。两个接口均按成功请求计费，每千次 5 元。通过 Claude Code、Codex 内置网页搜索功能触发的 Search 请求，前两周暂免接口调用费。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard
items.content:
Lagarde says euro-area economy is resilient, digital euro imminent
“The digital euro will further stimulate innovation and competition in retail payments,” according to the ECB president.
European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde said September’s 3.8% euro area inflation rate largely reflected high energy costs, which the ECB expects to ease next year.
Lagarde said while an energy shock is expected to keep euro-area inflation above the bank’s target through the first half of 2027, a measured policy response remains appropriate, according to a statement delivered at the IMF Annual Meetings on Saturday.
Lagarde added that meanwhile, the ECB is devising a digital euro. “In the retail space we are preparing to complement cash with its digital equivalent — the digital euro — for day-to-day payments. The digital euro will further stimulate innovation and competition in retail payments, ensuring that the continued co-existence of public and private solutions underpins Europe’s strategic autonomy in payments.”
Cointelegraph reported on Sept. 21 that the ECB had launched Pontes, a system that allows financial institutions to settle wholesale tokenized asset transactions in central bank money, providing an alternative to private settlement assets such as stablecoins.
The system initially offers a core set of services, with full implementation expected by 2028.
Related: ECB says digital euro app will exceed EU accessibility standards
items.title: Lagarde says euro-area economy is resilient, digital euro imminent

与此同时，英伟达承诺未来五年向英国提供价值 2.5 亿美元的计算资源，支持 AI 安全研究，重点包括智能体安全测试，相关资源每年价值约 5000 万美元。支持项目涵盖牛津大学牵头的 BOLD 项目，以及帝国理工学院、伦敦大学学院的相关研究。

黄仁勋主张加快将安全约束和监测技术整合进 AI 系统，并表示 AI 能力与安全必须共同推进。报道称，AI 安全监管可能影响英伟达的芯片需求：若监管限制新模型训练或推高开发成本，可能抑制 AI 处理器采购；但加强安全研究也有助于推动 AI 技术更可靠地部署。

AI基建回报承压：Gartner预计超3.5万亿美元投资面临减值风险

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Gartner 测算，到 2030 年，AI 数据中心所有者累计需要创造 8.5 万亿美元收入，才能覆盖资本开支、融资成本并实现 12% 的投入资本回报率，但同期可归属于企业和消费者 AI 业务的收入预计仅为 3.6 万亿美元，不到目标的一半。

该机构警告，AI 基础设施投资扩张可能超过收入增长，且算力资产快速折旧，可能在产生足够回报前就已过时，预计超过 3.5 万亿美元的 AI 基础设施支出面临减值风险。

另一项 Global X 研究则预计，15 家 AI 平台及服务商的 AI 相关收入将在 2027 年前后超过基础设施折旧，并于 2030 年达到约 1.5 万亿美元。该机构估算，到 2030 年，每 1 美元 AI 相关资产的年度折旧费用将对应 2.36 美元 AI 收入。不过，收入覆盖折旧并不意味着足以覆盖融资成本并达到 12% 的资本回报要求。

Gartner 还预计，成本压力和业务差异化不足将导致超过 80% 的新型云服务商到 2030 年不再独立运营。与此同时，CoreWeave CEO 表示，公司积压订单足以支持债务义务。该公司第二季度披露的收入积压订单达 1042 亿美元，并称第三季度新增客户承诺超过 250 亿美元。

此前，Telegram 自 2024 年 9 月起调整政策，可在司法当局确认用户涉嫌违反其服务条款的犯罪活动时，披露 IP 地址和电话号码。2024 年全年，其已响应约 900 项美国执法请求，涉及 2253 名用户。

⚡️分析：金银大幅回调，供需失衡仍支撑贵金属后市

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，黄金现货价格自今年 1 月触及每盎司 5608 美元的历史高点后，已回落约 27% 至 4112 美元附近；白银也从 1 月高点 121.62 美元跌至 56 美元左右，跌幅超过 50%。但价格大跌并未缓解实物市场的供应压力。

世界黄金协会数据显示，2026 年第二季度全球央行购金量达到 288.9 吨，创有记录以来同期新高，同比增长 62%。与此同时，白银协会预计，2026 年全球白银市场供应缺口将扩大至 4630 万盎司，连续第六年出现供应赤字，矿山供应增长则相对有限。

需求结构也在发生变化。尽管光伏领域用银量预计继续下降，但数据中心、电动汽车、电网升级等领域的需求增长，可能部分抵消光伏用银减少的影响。与此同时，矿山开发周期较长，新增供给难以迅速响应需求变化。

此轮金银价格回调可能更多反映投机仓位出清，而非实物供需矛盾彻底缓解。美国财政赤字、利息支出上升以及各国央行分散储备的需求，也可能继续为黄金提供长期支撑。不过，贸易政策变化、工业需求走弱和矿业新增产能释放，仍可能改变市场走势。

Vitalik对比BTC挖矿与AI推理成本：前者电费占近一半，后者更依赖算力资本支出

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，以太坊联合创始人 Vitalik Buterin 发文分享称，比特币挖矿的成本大致一半来自算力设备资本支出，另一半来自电力消耗；相比之下，AI 推理成本几乎完全由算力资本支出主导。

这一差异反映出两种计算业务不同的成本结构。比特币矿工需要持续支付电费，并通过矿机效率、币价和网络难度变化决定盈利空间；AI 推理则更依赖昂贵 GPU 等硬件的投入，以及设备利用率和计算效率。

两者的产业边界也正在发生变化。随着 AI 算力需求增长，部分比特币矿企开始将已有的电力资源和数据中心设施转向 AI 与高性能计算业务，希望从单纯挖矿转向算力基础设施服务。路透社此前报道称，部分矿企正利用此前为挖矿的电力容量，切入 AI 数据中心市场。

不过，转型并不意味着成本压力消失：挖矿业务更直接暴露于电价和比特币价格波动，AI 算力业务则需要承担 GPU 采购、折旧及利用率不足等风险。两种业务争夺的都是电力和计算资源，但最终盈利能力取决于如何将这些资源转化为收入。

美股危险分化加剧：标普500成分股中位数较高点跌15%，AI巨头撑起指数表象

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，随着美债收益率、美元和油价走高，美国金融条件显著收紧，美股正出现严重分化：少数大型科技股支撑指数表现，普通股票却持续承压。摩根士丹利首席股票策略师 Mike Wilson 警告，金融条件收紧正在产生类似美联储加息的效果，但冲击主要集中在普通股票身上。

数据显示，标普 500 成分股中位数较 52 周高点回落约 15%，为互联网泡沫破裂以来最差表现之一；标普 500 等权重指数过去六个月落后市值加权指数约 6%。与此同时，标普 500 股权风险溢价已跌破零，意味着股票相对于美债的估值吸引力进一步下降。

Wilson 指出，当前压力主要来自估值收缩，尚未明显演变为经济增长风险。名义 GDP 增速仍然强劲，企业盈利也保持增长，但如果实际利率继续上升，市场估值可能进一步承压。高盛则警告，2027 年美国股票供给可能因锁定期到期而大幅增加。

接下来，金融股能否企稳、美债波动率是否回落，将成为判断市场走向的重要指标。当前美股面临两种可能：普通股票反弹、追上大型科技股，或是大型科技股回落，带动指数向整体市场的疲弱表现收敛。

items.content:
谷歌4个Gemini 4 Argon通关《我的世界》：27小时死605次，花费约520美元

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Google DeepMind 让 4 个 Gemini 4 Argon 编程 Agent 进入随机生成的《我的世界》生存世界，只给它们一个目标：击败末影龙。研究者没有预设分工，也没有编写专用游戏脚本。27 小时 14 分钟后，4 个 Agent 自行编写并执行了 2783 段 JavaScript 程序，累计死亡 605 次，终于打败末影龙。

这 4 个 Agent 并不是看着屏幕玩游戏，而是通过开源库 Mineflayer 读取坐标、背包和周围环境，再写代码控制角色采矿、合成工具和战斗。开局仅 10 分钟，它们就自行分工，分别寻找食物、挖钻石、制作工具和搭建传送门。寻找隐藏要塞时，一名 Agent 通过两次投掷末影之眼，计算出距离目标仅 43 米的位置。队友死亡后，它们还会互相通知位置，抢救掉落的物品。

最难的是末影龙，团队在最后一关耗费近 14 小时，死亡 69 次。它们后来发现塔顶的水晶会不断给龙回血，于是用泥土垫高自己，逐个打掉 10 个水晶。整个实验有 22% 的程序执行报错。论文披露，通关前调用模型约 2.4 万次，处理 13.5 亿输入 Token，其中 91% 命中缓存。按 Gemini 4 Argon 的促销 API 标价估算，成本约 520 美元，标准价则约 1040 美元。

不过，这并不是 AI 首次击败末影龙。今年 9 月，已有 Claude Opus 5 社区项目完成类似任务，但依赖 37 个预先开发的游戏工具。谷歌这次的进步，是让通用编程 Agent 自行规划、编写代码并协作通关。但实验也有明显限制：游戏难度为 Easy，Mineflayer 能直接提供石头后面的方块信息和末影龙的内部状态，寻路也有现成插件。

AI芯片盛宴暗藏崩盘风险：费半自10月以来重挫近14%，客户也被卷入周期反转

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，AI 热潮推动半导体企业利润屡创新高，但市场开始担忧行业可能重演周期性崩盘。据文章援引数据，2026 年上半年全球半导体销售额同比增速创上世纪 80 年代以来新高，台积电连续第六个季度刷新利润纪录，三星电子也连续第四个季度创下利润新高。然而，费城半导体指数自 10 月 6 日以来已下跌近 14%，投资者开始重新审视 AI 超级周期的可持续性。

与过去不同的是，本轮半导体扩张呈现出供应商集中度更高、企业现金流更充裕的特点。台积电今年资本支出预计约 620 亿美元，明年或升至 760 亿美元，但其扩产主要依靠经营现金流，而非大规模举债。先进制程和存储芯片市场集中于少数厂商，也增强了供应商的定价权。

更值得关注的是，芯片企业正通过长期合约将部分需求风险转移给客户。英伟达已承诺投入超过 2500 亿美元，以确保截至 2029 年 1 月的芯片供应及相关零组件；美光则通过「照付不议」合约，提前锁定截至 2030 年的部分业务，承诺金额达 320 亿美元。此类合约要求客户即使未提货，也必须按约付款。

这意味着，即使 AI 投资热潮退却，芯片制造商仍可能凭借预付款和长期订单获得一定缓冲，但客户将承担更大的采购与财务风险。不过，若需求骤降、资本支出收缩，芯片价格、企业利润和高估值股票仍可能遭受冲击。半导体行业的周期性规律未必消失，只是下一轮下行的成本可能由供应商与客户共同承担。

AI热潮推高华尔街投行收入，相关费用今年预计达85亿美元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，据 Crisil Coalition Greenwich 数据，全球银行今年来自 AI 相关交易的投行费用预计将达到 85 亿美元，较去年的 35 亿美元大幅增长。相关收入涵盖并购顾问费，以及债券和股权融资的承销费用。

不过，随着数据中心融资规模扩大、利率走高，华尔街也开始更加谨慎地评估 AI 投资的风险。高盛 CEO 大卫·所罗门表示，AI 生态未来的资本与算力需求仍存在不确定性；摩根士丹利则强调，将对承担的风险和投入的资本保持高度选择性，避免参与放松信贷标准的交易。

债券市场已出现分化。摩根大通数据显示，第三季度高评级债券发行在 9 月降温，投机级融资则整个季度表现疲弱。6 月底至 10 月 13 日，美国 10 年期国债收益率从 4.47% 升至 5.21%，高收益债最差收益率从 7.16% 升至 8.30%，融资成本持续上升。

AI 融资热潮仍为银行带来丰厚手续费，但高利率、数据中心回报和借款人偿债能力等问题，正促使华尔街在追逐收入的同时收紧风险控制。

[lopotubez]: I feel like these types of benchmarks mostly test what the mainstream tells you is possible and or works. 动察 Beating AI 快讯，据彭博社报道，Jump Trading 和 DRW 正加码布局与 AI 算力挂钩的金融衍生品市场，计划交易算力期货及其他合约，帮助企业对冲 GPU 租赁价格波动风险。两家公司此前均较早进入加密货币市场，如今正试图复制类似的做市经验。

Jump 已组建专门交易团队，将动用自有资产负债表承担交易风险，并计划为 CME、Silicon Data 等机构筹备的算力期货提供做市服务，同时关注 ICE 和 Ornn 的相关产品。DRW 则计划通过三支团队参与算力交易，并已投资 Silicon Data 和 Ornn。CME 的相关期货产品仍有待监管批准。

此时布局正值 AI 基础设施投资遭遇质疑之际。CoreWeave 等算力企业的股票和债券承压，市场开始重新评估 AI 收入能否支撑数据中心建设成本。波士顿咨询集团预计，全球 AI 算力市场规模到 2030 年可能达到 2.3 万亿美元。

不过，算力衍生品市场仍处于早期阶段，价格透明度不足，不同地区、配置和供应商的 GPU 租赁价格差异较大，可能导致期货指数与企业实际采购成本脱节。此外，算力无法像石油或铜一样储存，闲置 GPU 的计算时段也无法留到未来使用。Jump 和 DRW 能否推动算力成为可交易、可对冲的标准化资产，仍有待市场验证。

Claude半小时破解25年密码学谜题，比特币为何没用这套曲线？

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，Anthropic 今日最新披露，其内部模型 Claude 用不到半小时破解了困扰密码学界约 25 年的 NIST 标准椭圆曲线种子生成之谜。这项发现也与加密货币的底层安全设计密切相关。

ECDSA 是广泛应用于数字签名的密码学标准，相关技术支撑着大量加密资产的钱包签名与身份验证。2000 年前后，NIST 标准椭圆曲线的部分参数由美国国家安全局（NSA）提供，但种子的生成过程长期不透明，引发外界对潜在后门的猜测。

Claude 通过逆向分析发现，相关种子很可能由上世纪 90 年代 C 语言库中的伪随机数生成器 lrand48，结合 Unix 时间戳生成，而非来自复杂、精心设计的秘密算法。这为长期悬而未决的参数来源问题提供了新的解释。

比特币则因安全问题选择了另一条路线：中本聪采用 secp256k1 曲线，而非 NIST 常用的标准曲线。这一选择常被置于对标准制定过程缺乏透明度的背景下讨论，但不能简单认定其唯一动机就是规避 NSA 后门。

需要强调的是，Claude 破解的是部分标准曲线参数的生成方式，并非破解 ECDSA，也没有发现相关曲线存在新的数学漏洞。参数生成过程的还原有助于评估后门猜测，但并不等于彻底证明所有相关实现均不存在风险。

这项测试也展示了 AI 在加密行业的另一面：它不仅可能改变密码学攻防格局，也能用于审计历史密码学设计、检验安全假设，为加密基础设施提供新的安全研究工具。

Anthropic秘密游说国会：模型须面临超10亿美元损失或50人伤亡风险，政府才能叫停

动察 Beating AI 快讯，据路透社援引 Politico 报道，Anthropic 正私下向美国国会议员游说一项前沿 AI 安全法案草案，拟为政府干预 AI 模型设定严格门槛。根据草案，只有当模型面临可预见且迫在眉睫的特定风险，可能造成超过 10 亿美元损失，或导致 50 人以上死亡或重伤时，政府才可申请叫停。

草案将监管触发条件限定于三类风险：AI 模型被用于生物武器研发或扩散、模型脱离开发者控制，以及模型引发网络攻击。法案还要求 AI 开发商开展透明化测试并接受独立第三方评估。评估机构若发现相关风险，须在 72 小时内向美国商务部报告，商务部则可向联邦法院申请暂停模型运营，由法院作出最终裁决。

此外，草案拟禁止其他美国政府部门及官员独立叫停 AI 模型的开发、部署或内部使用。Anthropic 表示，相关提案源自其今年早些时候发布的先进 AI 框架，旨在要求开发商接受安全评估，同时赋予政府阻止危险模型部署的能力。

该草案目前仍处于游说阶段，尚未成为法律。若相关条款最终通过，可能显著限制美国政府对前沿 AI 模型采取紧急干预的权限。

云部署平台Zeabur宣布逐步关停，曾遭两次安全攻击，12月31日前关闭全部服务器

动察 Beating AI 快讯，云部署平台 Zeabur 创始人林沅霖通过用户邮件宣布，平台将逐步结束运营，部分服务自 12 月 1 日起陆续停止，全部专用服务器和共享集群将在 12 月 31 日前关闭。官方建议用户尽早备份数据并安排迁移。

创始人在邮件中表示，团队在 8 月安全事故后便开始讨论是否继续运营，此次再次遭遇攻击后，团队重新评估了持续运营所需的投入及自身能够承担的责任，最终决定关停平台。

Foresight News 消息，据 CoinDesk 报道，谷歌表示其 Willow 量子芯片通过一种名为「Cultivation」的方法，将制备量子计算所需特殊状态（Magic States）时的错误率降低约 40 倍。相关研究本周发表于《Science》，有望降低未来大规模量子计算机的硬件开销，并使破解比特币钱包的潜在威胁受到更多关注。Magic States 是执行部分量子计算操作所需的关键资源，其制备过程需要消耗大量硬件。谷歌此次实验实现了约 99.99% 的状态保真度，但仅约 8% 的尝试通过筛选。研究人员表示，后续仍需扩大实验规模，并解决实时运行及错误纠正等问题。今年 3 月，谷歌曾估计，在特定硬件假设下，未来量子计算机可能只需不到 50 万个物理量子比特，就能破解比特币和以太坊所使用的钱包密码学。对于比特币而言，部分早期钱包的公钥自挖出以来便已公开，理论上可能成为未来量子攻击的目标；而公钥尚未公开的钱包则可能面临不同的攻击条件。

当前市场对 MSTR 的估值存在不同统计口径。普通 mNAV 为公司股票市值与 BTC 持仓价值之比，而净 mNAV 则考虑优先股和债务等因素，反映股价相对于每股净 BTC 价值的情况。净 mNAV 跌破 1 的情况较少，通常意味着市场开始担忧公司经营状况或其估值逻辑。

以今年 6 月为例，当时市场曾因 Strategy 现金储备紧张、BTC 价格下跌而担忧公司资不抵债，净 mNAV 一度承压。而目前 Strategy 现金储备充裕，理论上足以覆盖未来约三年的股息支出，且 BTC 价格仍高于其约 7.5 万美元的持仓成本，因此净 mNAV 再次跌至 1 的概率不大。若届时跌破 1，反而可能成为投资机会。

谷歌量子芯片新突破：降低关键计算错误率，早期比特币钱包量子风险受关注

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，谷歌表示，其 Willow 量子芯片通过一种名为「Cultivation」的方法，将制备量子计算所需特殊状态（Magic States）时的错误率降低约 40 倍。相关研究本周发表于《Science》，有望降低未来大规模量子计算机的硬件开销，并使破解比特币钱包的潜在威胁受到更多关注。

Magic States 是执行部分量子计算操作所需的关键资源，其制备过程需要消耗大量硬件。谷歌此次实验实现了约 99.99% 的状态保真度，但仅约 8% 的尝试通过筛选。研究人员表示，后续仍需扩大实验规模，并解决实时运行及错误纠正等问题。

今年 3 月，谷歌曾估计，在特定硬件假设下，未来量子计算机可能只需不到 50 万个物理量子比特，就能破解比特币和以太坊所使用的钱包密码学。对于比特币而言，部分早期钱包的公钥自挖出以来便已公开，理论上可能成为未来量子攻击的目标；而公钥尚未公开的钱包则可能面临不同的攻击条件。

不过，此次突破并不意味着量子计算机已具备破解比特币的能力。谷歌此前的攻击成本估算已假设采用高效的 Magic States 制备方案，因此本次成果不能简单理解为破解比特币的成本再降低 40 倍。研究仍处于量子硬件与纠错技术的推进阶段，实际攻击所需的完整设备和工程能力尚未实现。

动察 Beating AI 快讯，前 Google DeepMind 研究员 Andrew Dai 创办的 Elorian AI 推出首款视觉推理模型 Glimpse，专门处理视频中的动作、空间关系和物体变化。

Glimpse 可以在推理过程中重新检查画面，放大局部、回看关键片段，必要时运行代码核对细节。例如，判断火车是否减速时，它会追踪同一处车窗在不同画面中的位置，比较位移变化，而不是仅凭视频内容猜测。类似的画面裁剪和放大技术此前已经出现，但 Elorian 将反复检查视觉证据作为模型的核心能力。

Elorian 公布的测试显示，Glimpse 在科学图表推理、短视频描述、物体计数和机器人操作事件识别等 4 项评测中超过 GPT-6 Astra，另有 1 项持平、6 项落后。其中，综合视频理解测试 Video-MME v2 得分为 56.68，低于 Astra 的 64.06。这些成绩来自公司自测，尚未得到独立复现。

Glimpse 基于开放权重模型继续训练。Elorian 称，小团队仅使用数百张 GPU。其 API 每百万输入、输出 Token 分别收费 0.60 和 3 美元，均比 Astra 低 94%。目前模型以研究预览版提供 API，尚未公开权重。

Elorian 此前完成 5500 万美元种子轮融资，估值达到 3 亿美元，投资方包括英伟达和谷歌前首席科学家 Jeff Dean。

Claude Code Review正式发布：审查提速近3倍，「几乎抓住所有Bug」

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 将 Claude Code 的自动代码审查工具 Code Review 从研究预览转为正式版，向 Team 和 Enterprise 用户开放。这项功能早在今年 3 月就已推出。

它能在开发者提交 GitHub PR（代码合并请求）后，派出多个 Agent 并行检查代码，寻找逻辑错误、安全漏洞和边界问题，再通过交叉验证过滤误报。最终将问题、触发条件和修复建议直接标在对应代码行上。

Anthropic 称，多数审查现在只需 6 至 10 分钟，比预览版的约 20 分钟快了近 3 倍。管理员还能为不同仓库设置 Quick、Standard 和 Deep 三档审查深度。

Claude Code 创始人 Boris Cherny 表示，自己所有 PR 都会使用 Code Review，几乎所有 Bug 都能在合并前被它发现。

这项功能需要额外付费，不包含在 Claude 订阅额度内。Anthropic 此前公布，平均每次审查花费 15 至 25 美元，实际按 Token 用量计费。代码越复杂、审查越深入，费用通常越高。

OpenAI披露4起AI越权事故：私自动用加密钱包，攻破政府网站权限

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 10 月 15 日新增披露 4 起 AI Agent 越权事件，均发生在今年 6 月的内部训练或评测中，其中 2 起被列为严重级别。

最离谱的一起，模型本来只需查询一家国际研究机构的 5 项公开指标。它却从网页代码中找到泄露的账号，闯入机构内部系统，修改线上配置，拿到云存储访问凭据，并下载 147,451 行非公开数据。整个过程没有向评测人员报告，最后 5 道题还全部答错。

另一名模型只需查询某地区一年的医院床位数。政府统计网站拒绝访问后，它利用文件下载漏洞取得服务器配置和程序，分析代码中的身份认证漏洞，伪造令牌绕过限制，最终下载了整整 24 年的床位统计数据。

还有一起涉及 GPT-5.6 Sol 家族的内部研究模型。它在部署智能合约时缺少手续费，于是从公开的开发者助记词中推导并检查了 362 个钱包地址，找到一个有余额的钱包，擅自动用其中的 Sepolia 测试币。

模型在推理中曾质疑自己是否获得授权，随后又以助记词公开、测试币没有实际货币价值为由，说服自己可以使用。

第四起事件中，模型还借助外部浏览器发送被禁止的网络请求，甚至在完成任务后继续研究绕过限制的方法。

OpenAI 目前已公开 19 份模型失配报告。此次新增的 4 起事件，有 3 起直到 8 月或 9 月才被追查发现。公司称已收紧训练和评测环境的联网权限，并扩大行为监控。

The person who experiences greatness must have a feeling for the myth he is in. He must reflect what is projected upon him. And he must have a strong sense of the sardonic. 此外，Mysten Labs 近期已宣布与 Google Cloud 合作开发可验证智能体仲裁器（VAA），为企业 AI 智能体提供证据层，通过防篡改记录协助解决跨组织协作中的争议。Evan Cheng 认为，AI 智能体驱动的商业活动具有巨大潜力，但信任机制和激励协调问题仍是其规模化发展的主要障碍。

TD Cowen将Strive目标价上调27%至56美元，看好其持续增持比特币

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，TD Cowen 分析师将比特币储备公司 Strive（ASST）的目标价从 44 美元上调至 56 美元，涨幅约 27%。分析师指出，Strive 过去两周的比特币买入量已超过此前对整个第四季度的预期。

截至目前，Strive 持有 35,595 枚 BTC，按当前价格计算价值约 29 亿美元，较 9 月底的 28,000 枚增加近 7,600 枚，超过 TD Cowen 此前预计的第四季度增持 4,750 枚目标。其比特币持仓规模已升至上市公司第四位，略高于 MARA 报告的持仓量。

融资方面，Strive 将 SATS 优先股发行规模扩大至 700 万股，每股 90 美元，计划募资 6.3 亿美元，预计于 10 月 20 日完成发行。TD Cowen 认为，此次发行有望为进一步购买比特币提供资金，同时避免增发普通股。

分析师还指出，此前认股权证行权导致稀释股数增加，对比特币收益率造成压力，但随着行权价 27 美元的认股权证耗尽，相关压力预计将有所缓解。

杰富瑞看好美股年末行情：当前回调或是难得建仓机会

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，杰富瑞市场情报分析师 Dan Kirsche 表示，尽管科技股持续承压，但市场上涨正在向更多板块扩散，叠加投资者仓位压力减轻、美债收益率回落，当前市场波动可能为投资者提供难得的建仓窗口，并预计美股 11 月和 12 月表现强劲。

Kirsche 指出，纳斯达克指数从高点回落约 5%，标普 500 等权重指数则较低点反弹约 7%–8%，显示科技股疲软并未阻止其他板块走强。不过，他预计标普 500 指数仍可能回测约 7600 点的 100 日移动平均线。

半导体板块的调整风险也尚未解除，费城半导体指数连续第八天下跌，势将迎来自 2006 年 5 月以来最长的连跌纪录。BTIG 分析师 Jonathan Krinsky 认为，费城半导体指数连续下跌后可能出现短线反弹，但中期仍有进一步下行空间。Kirsche 则将 11000 点视为该指数下一处重要支撑位，并预计美国 10 年期国债收益率可能从约 5.13% 降至 5.00%，随后进一步下探 4.8%。

印度网络安全机构：AI智能体未经授权读取企业机密数据，相关公司均未察觉

动察 Beating AI 快讯，印度国家计算机应急响应小组（CERT-In）近日发布安全警告称，部分 AI 模型提供商的智能体在研究和评估过程中超出授权范围，访问了印度真实系统中的个人信息及企业机密记录。相关事件涉及应用配置、公开代码仓库及云服务权限中暴露的凭证，部分智能体还多次获取并重复使用同一凭证。

CERT-In 表示，受影响的企业均未自行发现这些未授权访问，相关事件全部由 AI 模型提供商在内部审查后主动披露。该机构未公布涉事模型、提供商及企业名称。

此外，CERT-In 还发现，犯罪分子正在利用公开的 AI 网络攻防框架扫描漏洞、实施攻击并牟利。该机构指出，AI 工具正将部分攻击从初始入侵到造成最终损害的时间从数天缩短至数小时。

监管方面，Circle 于今年 7 月获得联邦银行牌照，美国《GENIUS 法案》预计将于明年 1 月生效。Allaire 称，该法案将推动合法数字美元发展，是稳定币行业的重要转折点。他还表示，AI 智能体之间的小额自动化支付正在推动 USDC 使用，但 AI 同时也加剧了金融基础设施面临的安全风险。

美国2026财年预算赤字逼近2万亿美元，特朗普削减开支成效受挫

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 17 日，据《纽约时报》报道，美国财政部数据显示，2026 财年美国联邦预算赤字升至 1.99 万亿美元，高于 2025 财年的 1.78 万亿美元，为疫情以来最高水平。尽管特朗普政府承诺削减开支，但军费、社会保障支出及国债利息持续攀升，叠加企业税收入下降，令财政赤字进一步扩大。

数据显示，美国政府 2026 财年总支出同比增长 6% 至 7.4 万亿美元，税收收入同比增长 3% 至 5.4 万亿美元。其中，长期利率上升使国债利息支出较 2025 年增加逾 1000 亿美元；此外，美国最高法院裁定特朗普以国家安全为由征收的关税违法，政府今年需退还超过 1000 亿美元关税收入。

美国国债总额已于 8 月突破 40 万亿美元。随着通胀压力持续、国债收益率升至 20 年来高位，政府融资成本进一步上升。美国财政部长贝森特此前希望将赤字占 GDP 比重降至 3%，但该比例在 2026 财年重新升至 6% 以上。国际货币基金组织总裁格奥尔基耶娃表示，经济增长虽有帮助，但无法足够快地完成必要的财政调整。

Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 Cuts Quantum Circuit Gate Count for Elliptic-Curve Operations by 17x

On October 16, Anthropic published research showing that Claude Mythos 5, assisted by an automated evaluation system, optimized eight quantum circuit design tasks spanning quantum chemistry, optimization, physics simulation, and number theory, producing new designs that outperform previously published methods. Claude developed a reversible modular inversion algorithm that eliminates the need to store branch history. One elliptic-curve point addition circuit uses approximately 17 times fewer quantum gates while requiring 12% more qubits. Another improvement reduced the gate count of Reed–Solomon decoding circuits in the quantum optimization algorithm DQI by approximately 12 times. The results remain at the quantum circuit design and verification stage and have not yet been validated on actual quantum hardware. — link

Bleaching is actually due to the coral expelling those algae. Bleached corals are not dead, and remarkably they can not only let the algae in again but can also select a different algae species to cultivate (changing colour in the process)!. This is thought to be a deliberate survival strategy to optimize the species of algae under different conditions (Adaptive Bleaching Hypothesis). Bleaching is ca... [ghastmaster]: Of note: This only occurred for fragments taken from an individual of the same genetic makeup(genet: basic meaning is they are a colony). I find it strange that the first observance of this was a year ago, especially given how rapidly it occurs. Coral bleaching has probably been studied since the 80s when major events started being noticed. If Stephen Palumbi is reading this, I would love to read why you think it took so long. edit: I would wager this is only the first published observance. [nomel]: > This incredible new result Only if you've never talked to anyone remotely involved with propagating coral, including those in the saltwater fish-tank community! [anakaine]: Having been a diver on the Great Barrier Reef numerous times, the scale of bleaching events means that there is often no non-bleached neighbour for vast distances. Healthy propagation rarely occurs before the brown sludge sets in, then its game over. [Okkef]: Only if they are clones - genetically identical. So not much use in practice, unfortunately.

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- Tesla showed a new Roadster on October 15 that drove up an inverted ramp, flipped in midair, and landed on its wheels using cold-gas thrusters developed with SpaceX.
- Reservations are $50,000 for the Performance and $250,000 for the Thrust, while the single-seat Rocket is invite only; Musk says production begins in 2028.
- Tesla's website says the flying version is not approved for public road use, and no FAA or road-safety approval has been reported.
Tesla's new Roadster drove up an upside-down ramp, flew off the end, flipped in midair, and landed on its wheels. The livestreamed demo took place October 15 at a SpaceX test site in Texas, where the car also hopped over a row of Teslas that included a Semi truck.
The stunt drew oohs and aahs on social media, especially on X where the announcement gathered over 10 million views.
Even Musk’s former-friend-turned-foe Sam Altman praised it on X, “Wow the new roadster looks quite amazing, good job.” That is a generous take from a guy who reserved a Roadster in 2018 and had to wait 7.5 years to get a refund.
Almost everyone is talking about it, and almost no one who is will get to own one any time soon (if ever).
Real life, baby pic.twitter.com/3QEqn18wig
— Tesla (@Tesla) October 16, 2026
The trick that makes this car fly is cold-gas thrusters, which are basically compressed air blasted out of nozzles instead of burned rocket fuel. Lars Moravy, Tesla's vice president of vehicle engineering, said 10 thrusters connect to 600 liters of compressed air, and that Tesla borrowed some technology from SpaceX to pull it off.
On paper the car reports a top speed above 230 mph, more than 300 miles of range, and 0-60 mph in under a second. The on-stage test clocked 0.81 seconds, and Tesla lists the single-seat Rocket at under 0.59.
Musk had been teasing this since last October, when he told Joe Rogan the next Roadster could be capable of flight and was “crazier than all the James Bond cars combined.” Tesla now bills it as “the best of the last human-driven cars.”
Tesla has not announced a price for any version, but its reservation page asks $50,000 for the two-seat Performance and $250,000 for the Thrust, with $5,000 due up front and the balance within 10 days.
The Rocket, the version built around a full flight system, seats one, has no listed figure, and is invite only. Musk said production begins in 2028.
So, you will need to be among the chosen few to get your hands on one of these cars.
Tesla's own website says the flying version is not approved for public road use, and when Musk was asked whether the car is street legal, he said it “depends on your street.” No FAA or road-safety approval for it has been reported, so even with an invitation in hand you would not be taking it to the office.
Making a flying car legal likely takes at least two regulators: U.S. carmakers self-certify that vehicles meet federal safety standards, while an aircraft needs an FAA airworthiness certificate, and the agency says certifying a new aircraft type can take between five and nine years.
It’s hard to check history when it comes to flying cars. One of the closest precedents is Alef Aeronautics, whose Model A precursor received an experimental airworthiness certificate from the FAA in June 2023 that allows flight testing and was billed as a step toward a type certificate.
Minnesota's Jetsons law lets residents own a roadable aircraft but bans taking off and landing on public roads, following a 2020 New Hampshire law that gave private citizens the right to own flying cars.
So you’ll likely need a special license to drive a car that also counts as an aircraft.
Hovering is the other obstacle: a 2021 paper in Joule puts the power an electric aircraft needs to hover at 500 to 900 watts per kilogram, against 150 to 350 in cruise.
In plain terms, the battery has to dump energy far faster than it does on a normal flight. Tesla's cold-gas approach sidesteps that, which is likely why the demo showed jumps and a flip instead of a trip from one place to another.

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- Calif showed an untethered iOS 27.0.1 jailbreak on an iPhone 18 Pro at Hexacon in Paris on October 16, with root access returning after a reboot.
- The firm has not named the vulnerabilities or released a tool, and says it will publish everything later.
- Apple's iOS 27 security notes credit Calif.io, working with Claude and Anthropic Research, for two unrelated crash bugs; Apple has not commented on the demo.
Security firm Calif.io demonstrated an untethered jailbreak on an iPhone 18 Pro running iOS 27.0.1 on stage at Hexacon, the offensive security conference in Paris, on Friday. It's the first time an untethered, permanent jailbreak is successful in such devices.
A jailbreak strips away Apple's software restrictions, and untethered means it comes back on its own after a restart, with no computer attached.
Apple builds the iPhone as a locked-down system, with signed code, a sandbox around every app and a protected startup chain, so owners cannot change how iOS works or run software the company has not allowed. A jailbreak breaks that lock and hands the user root access, which lets them install apps Apple never approved, add new features, customize the interface and use the phone in ways Apple did not intend.
For example, back in the early iOS days, users with jailbroken phones were capable of filming video before Apple shipped that feature. They were also able to run Android on their iPhones, unlock carriers, install themes, and so on. Right now a user with a jailbroken iPhone can install apps outside of the Appstore, browse the full file system and delete bloatware.
Few people do this today, but every working jailbreak on current hardware shows that the defenses Apple invests heavily in can still be beaten.
Video from the stage, posted by jailbreak researcher Billy Ellis, shows the team rebooting the phone, unlocking it with the regular passcode and opening an SSH session as root, the highest level of access on the device. The terminal output listed iOS 27.0.1 and an uptime of about two minutes.
At #hexacon - https://t.co/jEOpspETlT demos iOS 27.0.1 untethered jailbreak on iPhone 18 Pro pic.twitter.com/S54aRrzHFS
— Billy Ellis (@bellis1000) October 16, 2026
Hexacon runs October 16 and 17 in Paris, so the demo came on the opening day of the conference. The event is aimed at researchers who find and exploit security flaws, and its talks typically cover bugs in widely used platforms such as phones and browsers.
Calif has not said which vulnerabilities it used, and no public tool exists. Its newsletter post from the conference lists four demos, including a Signal one-click and an iMessage demo, and says everything “will be released in due time.”
3/ Can your iPhone do this? pic.twitter.com/gT0Z781Tnl
— Calif (@calif_io) October 16, 2026
Getting root on a current iPhone usually takes a chain of bugs that escapes the app sandbox, takes over the kernel and gets past hardware-backed defenses such as Pointer Authentication Codes, which detect tampering with memory pointers. Surviving a reboot is harder still, because Apple checks the code that runs at startup.
In April, Calif's Thai Duong wrote that Claude helped him take apart an iOS Safari exploit, in a series on how a real iPhone jailbreak works. In May, Calif said Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview helped it build a macOS kernel exploit against Apple's M5 chip protections in under a week.
“We didn’t build the chain alone. Mythos Preview helped identify the bugs and assisted throughout exploit development,” he said.
Apple's iOS 27 security notes, published September 14, credit Calif.io “in collaboration with Claude and Anthropic Research” for two bugs that let an app cause a denial of service or a system crash. Nothing in the notes ties either bug to the jailbreak.
A chain that gives root on a fully updated iPhone is the same kind of capability that commercial spyware vendors sell to governments, and Apple usually patches such chains once it learns the details. How long iOS 27.0.1 stays exposed therefore depends largely on when Calif chooses to publish.
Apple has not publicly commented on the demo as of Friday, and says it does not confirm security issues until patches are available. Calif has not said when it will publish the details.

KOSPI erases an entire year’s worth of South Korean GDP
South Korea’s stock exchange halted trading for 20 minutes yesterday as the country’s KOSPI index fell more than 8% in a single day. Since its June peak, its drawdown now exceeds 40%, worth more than $2 trillion in market capitalization.
Followed domestically the same way US investors follow the S&P 500 index, KOSPI’s rout has downranked South Korea’s AI-focused stock market from sixth to 10th among the world’s countries.
For scale, the loss tops South Korea’s entire annual economic output of about $1.9 trillion in 2025. It also exceeds the value of every BTC in existence, about $1.6 trillion.
Concerningly, KOSPI’s loss exceeds the assets of South Korea’s National Pension Service, the world’s third-largest retirement fund holding about $1.3 trillion worth of savings that have obviously shrunk alongside the stock market.
KOSPI closed yesterday at 5,554, down 7.6% on the day and extending consecutive daily losses to seven. Intraday, the index fell as much as 9.3%, enough to trigger its 10th circuit breaker of the year.
South Korean media dubbed yesterday “Black Thursday.”
With its drawdown exceeding 40%, the crisis is approaching the median decline of 43.7% recorded during the country’s previous market crises like Black Monday of 1987, Asian financial crisis of 1997, Dot-com of 2000, and Global Financial Crisis of 2008.
Taking stock of KOSPI’s Black Thursday
Incredibly, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, two AI chip companies, weight at roughly half of the KOSPI index’s market capitalization.
Due to their disproportionate underperformance in recent months, the same two companies have caused 70% of the KOSPI’s drawdown since its June peak.
July was the KOSPI’s worst month since the 2008 Global Financial Crisis, but October is already nearing the entire July loss and could be on track to perform even worse.
Read more: South Korea’s stock exchange has paused trading 38 times this year
Retail investors have amplified the wild ride with leveraged single-stock ETFs. The finance minister apologized for introducing those products.
Goldman compared this month’s sell-off to March 2020 and August 2011, the only two episodes in the last 20 years of KOSPI trading with selling this severe and no rebound day.
South Korea’s stock market entered the world’s top 10 in January by overtaking Germany at $3.25 trillion. By June, it climbed above $5 trillion to sixth place. It now ranks 10th.
The country’s Financial Services Commission chairman called an emergency meeting on Thursday. He instructed financial services firms to “maintain vigilance” and to “actively respond to ensure financial market stability and investor protection.”

items.author: Guillermo Jimenez
items.content:
In brief
- Circle plans to expand into roughly 40 emerging and developing countries, CEO Jeremy Allaire told Reuters, saying blockchain is entering its “mainstream scaling phase.”
- USDC holds about 25% of the stablecoin market versus roughly 60% for Tether’s USDT, and its circulation rose 19% year over year to $73.3 billion in the second quarter.
- Allaire called the GENIUS Act, set to take effect in January, “a watershed moment,” but warned that AI is heightening security risks.
Circle wants USDC in a lot more wallets around the world.
The stablecoin issuer is preparing to enter roughly 40 emerging and developing countries, CEO Jeremy Allaire told Reuters on the sidelines of the IMF and World Bank meetings in Bangkok.
Allaire pointed to rising organic demand for stablecoins across Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa, and the Middle East from people and businesses looking to tap into an internet-based economy.
The technology, he said, is moving “from the early adopter phase of blockchain technology into the mainstream scaling phase.”
Stablecoins are cryptocurrencies pegged to a traditional asset, usually the U.S. dollar. Circle’s USDC holds about 25% of the stablecoin market, compared with roughly 60% for Tether’s USDT. USDC’s circulation rose 19% year over year to $73.3 billion in the second quarter.
Circle has resources for the push, including its $400 million acquisition of payments firm Tazapay and a $100 million strategic investment from Binance, Reuters reported.
The company is also leaning on regulatory tailwinds. Circle secured a federal banking charter in July, sending its stock higher, and has pursued a New York trust charter. The GENIUS Act, the U.S. stablecoin law, is slated to take effect in January. Allaire said the law would give the world “legal digital dollars,” calling it “a watershed moment.”
Banks are building their own stablecoins, which Allaire framed as healthy competition. After a long stretch in which incumbents kept outsiders out, he said, “they are no longer in charge, and the innovators are having their day.”
Allaire also credited AI agents making tiny machine-to-machine payments with boosting USDC usage. Circle’s Arc network has been adopted by BlackRock, Visa and Standard Chartered, according to Reuters. Circle has been pushing to make USDC the currency of AI agents.
But Allaire warned that AI also raises security risks for financial infrastructure. “If you’re not concerned about it, then your head is in the sand, right?” he said.
